algorithms.name: LinearRegression
algorithms.description: Минимизирует сумму квадратов ошибок.
algorithms.explanation: У каждой строки есть ошибка y−ŷ. МНК возводит ошибки в квадрат и складывает. Свободный член b не штрафуется.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to calculate the intercept for this model. If set to False, no intercept will be used in calculations (i.e. data is expected to be centered).

params.label: copy_X
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: If True, X will be copied; else, it may be overwritten.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The precision of the solution (`coef_`) is determined by `tol` which specifies a different convergence criterion for the `lsqr` solver. `tol` is set as `atol` and `btol` of :func:`scipy.sparse.linalg.lsqr` when fitting on sparse training data. This parameter has no effect when fitting on dense data. .. versionadded:: 1.7

params.label: n_jobs
params.help: Число разрешенных параллельных исполнителей.
params.constructor_doc: The number of jobs to use for the computation. This will only provide speedup in case of sufficiently large problems, that is if firstly `n_targets > 1` and secondly `X` is sparse or if `positive` is set to `True`. ``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context. ``-1`` means using all processors. See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>` for more details.

params.label: positive
params.help: Запретить отрицательные коэффициенты поддерживающей модели.
params.constructor_doc: When set to ``True``, forces the coefficients to be positive. This option is only supported for dense arrays. For a comparison between a linear regression model with positive constraints on the regression coefficients and a linear regression without such constraints, see :ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_linear_model_plot_nnls.py`. .. versionadded:: 0.24

algorithms.name: Ridge
algorithms.description: Сжимает коэффициенты квадратичным штрафом.
algorithms.explanation: Коэффициенты обычно уменьшаются плавно. Нормировка sklearn Ridge: сумма квадратов без деления на n. При общей цели RSS/(2n)+λ‖w‖²/2 нужно alpha=n·λ.

params.label: alpha
params.help: Сила штрафа выбранной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Constant that multiplies the L2 term, controlling regularization strength. `alpha` must be a non-negative float i.e. in `[0, inf)`. When `alpha = 0`, the objective is equivalent to ordinary least squares, solved by the :class:`LinearRegression` object. For numerical reasons, using `alpha = 0` with the `Ridge` object is not advised. Instead, you should use the :class:`LinearRegression` object. If an array is passed, penalties are assumed to be specific to the targets. Hence they must correspond in number.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to fit the intercept for this model. If set to false, no intercept will be used in calculations (i.e. ``X`` and ``y`` are expected to be centered).

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations for conjugate gradient solver. For 'sparse_cg' and 'lsqr' solvers, the default value is determined by scipy.sparse.linalg. For 'sag' solver, the default value is 1000. For 'lbfgs' solver, the default value is 15000.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The precision of the solution (`coef_`) is determined by `tol` which specifies a different convergence criterion for each solver: - 'svd': `tol` has no impact. - 'cholesky': `tol` has no impact. - 'sparse_cg': norm of residuals smaller than `tol`. - 'lsqr': `tol` is set as atol and btol of scipy.sparse.linalg.lsqr, which control the norm of the residual vector in terms of the norms of matrix and coefficients. - 'sag' and 'saga': relative change of coef smaller than `tol`. - 'lbfgs': maximum of the absolute (projected) gradient=max|residuals| smaller than `tol`. .. versionchanged:: 1.2 Default value changed from 1e-3 to 1e-4 for consistency with other linear models.

params.label: solver
params.help: Алгоритм, который подбирает внутренние параметры модели.
params.constructor_doc: Solver to use in the computational routines: - 'auto' chooses the solver automatically based on the type of data. - 'svd' uses a Singular Value Decomposition of X to compute the Ridge coefficients. It is the most stable solver, in particular more stable for singular matrices than 'cholesky' at the cost of being slower. - 'cholesky' uses the standard :func:`scipy.linalg.solve` function to obtain a closed-form solution. - 'sparse_cg' uses the conjugate gradient solver as found in :func:`scipy.sparse.linalg.cg`. As an iterative algorithm, this solver is more appropriate than 'cholesky' for large-scale data (possibility to set `tol` and `max_iter`). - 'lsqr' uses the dedicated regularized least-squares routine :func:`scipy.sparse.linalg.lsqr`. It is the fastest and uses an iterative procedure. - 'sag' uses a Stochastic Average Gradient descent, and 'saga' uses its improved, unbiased version named SAGA. Both methods also use an iterative procedure, and are often faster than other solvers when both n_samples and n_features are large. Note that 'sag' and 'saga' fast convergence is only guaranteed on features with approximately the same scale. You can preprocess the data with a scaler from :mod:`sklearn.preprocessing`. - 'lbfgs' uses L-BFGS-B algorithm implemented in :func:`scipy.optimize.minimize`. It can be used only when `positive` is True. All solvers except 'svd' support both dense and sparse data. However, only 'lsqr', 'sag', 'sparse_cg', and 'lbfgs' support sparse input when `fit_intercept` is True. .. versionadded:: 0.17 Stochastic Average Gradient descent solver. .. versionadded:: 0.19 SAGA solver.

params.label: copy_X
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: If True, X will be copied; else, it may be overwritten.

params.label: positive
params.help: Запретить отрицательные коэффициенты поддерживающей модели.
params.constructor_doc: When set to ``True``, forces the coefficients to be positive. Only 'lbfgs' solver is supported in this case.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Used when ``solver`` == 'sag' or 'saga' to shuffle the data. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>` for details. .. versionadded:: 0.17 `random_state` to support Stochastic Average Gradient.

algorithms.name: Lasso
algorithms.description: Может сделать коэффициенты точно нулевыми.
algorithms.explanation: Штраф складывает модули коэффициентов. Нулевой коэффициент исключает признак. Путь по alpha состоит из решений разных задач. При alpha=0 используйте МНК.

params.label: alpha
params.help: Сила штрафа выбранной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Constant that multiplies the L1 term, controlling regularization strength. `alpha` must be a non-negative float i.e. in `[0, inf)`. When `alpha = 0`, the objective is equivalent to ordinary least squares, solved by the :class:`LinearRegression` object. For numerical reasons, using `alpha = 0` with the `Lasso` object is not advised. Instead, you should use the :class:`LinearRegression` object.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to calculate the intercept for this model. If set to False, no intercept will be used in calculations (i.e. data is expected to be centered).

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The maximum number of iterations.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The tolerance for the optimization: if the updates are smaller or equal to ``tol``, the optimization code checks the dual gap for optimality and continues until it is smaller or equal to ``tol``, see Notes below.

params.label: positive
params.help: Запретить отрицательные коэффициенты поддерживающей модели.
params.constructor_doc: When set to ``True``, forces the coefficients to be positive.

params.label: precompute
params.help: Заранее вычислять матрицу попарных скалярных произведений признаков для решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to use a precomputed Gram matrix to speed up calculations. The Gram matrix can also be passed as argument. For sparse input this option is always ``False`` to preserve sparsity.
params.documented_type: bool or array-like of shape (n_features, n_features),                 default=False

params.label: copy_X
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: If ``True``, X will be copied; else, it may be overwritten.

params.label: warm_start
params.help: Переиспользовать уже обученное состояние при повторном fit того же экземпляра.
params.constructor_doc: When set to ``True``, reuse the solution of the previous call to fit as initialization, otherwise, just erase the previous solution. See :term:`the Glossary <warm_start>`.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: The seed of the pseudo random number generator that selects a random feature to update. Used when ``selection`` == 'random'. Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.

params.label: selection
params.help: Порядок обновления координат Lasso или ElasticNet.
params.constructor_doc: If set to 'random', a random coefficient is updated every iteration rather than looping over features sequentially by default. This (setting to 'random') often leads to significantly faster convergence especially when tol is higher than 1e-4.

algorithms.name: ElasticNet
algorithms.description: Совмещает разреженность и сжатие.
algorithms.explanation: r — доля L1. Смешанный штраф полезен при похожих признаках. r близко к нулю может затруднять координатный решатель; чистый L2 удобнее запускать через Ridge с учетом нормировки.

params.label: alpha
params.help: Сила штрафа выбранной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Constant that multiplies the penalty terms. Defaults to 1.0. See the notes for the exact mathematical meaning of this parameter. ``alpha = 0`` is equivalent to an ordinary least square, solved by the :class:`LinearRegression` object. For numerical reasons, using ``alpha = 0`` with the ``Lasso`` object is not advised. Given this, you should use the :class:`LinearRegression` object.

params.label: l1_ratio
params.help: Доля L1 в смеси L1 и L2.
params.constructor_doc: The ElasticNet mixing parameter, with ``0 <= l1_ratio <= 1``. For ``l1_ratio = 0`` the penalty is an L2 penalty. ``For l1_ratio = 1`` it is an L1 penalty. For ``0 < l1_ratio < 1``, the penalty is a combination of L1 and L2.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether the intercept should be estimated or not. If ``False``, the data is assumed to be already centered.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The maximum number of iterations.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The tolerance for the optimization: if the updates are smaller or equal to ``tol``, the optimization code checks the dual gap for optimality and continues until it is smaller or equal to ``tol``, see Notes below.

params.label: precompute
params.help: Заранее вычислять матрицу попарных скалярных произведений признаков для решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to use a precomputed Gram matrix to speed up calculations. The Gram matrix can also be passed as argument. For sparse input this option is always ``False`` to preserve sparsity. Check :ref:`an example on how to use a precomputed Gram Matrix in ElasticNet <sphx_glr_auto_examples_linear_model_plot_elastic_net_precomputed_gram_matrix_with_weighted_samples.py>` for details.
params.documented_type: bool or array-like of shape (n_features, n_features),                 default=False

params.label: copy_X
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: If ``True``, X will be copied; else, it may be overwritten.

params.label: warm_start
params.help: Переиспользовать уже обученное состояние при повторном fit того же экземпляра.
params.constructor_doc: When set to ``True``, reuse the solution of the previous call to fit as initialization, otherwise, just erase the previous solution. See :term:`the Glossary <warm_start>`.

params.label: positive
params.help: Запретить отрицательные коэффициенты поддерживающей модели.
params.constructor_doc: When set to ``True``, forces the coefficients to be positive.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: The seed of the pseudo random number generator that selects a random feature to update. Used when ``selection`` == 'random'. Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.

params.label: selection
params.help: Порядок обновления координат Lasso или ElasticNet.
params.constructor_doc: If set to 'random', a random coefficient is updated every iteration rather than looping over features sequentially by default. This (setting to 'random') often leads to significantly faster convergence especially when tol is higher than 1e-4.

algorithms.name: Lars
algorithms.description: Поэтапно включает признаки по связи с остатками.
algorithms.formula: r=y-Xw-b;\quad\text{движение по равным углам к активным признакам}
algorithms.explanation: Это алгоритм построения пути, а не название штрафа. coef_path_ содержит настоящие узлы алгоритма. Обычный LARS и LassoLars могут давать разные пути.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to calculate the intercept for this model. If set to false, no intercept will be used in calculations (i.e. data is expected to be centered).

params.label: n_nonzero_coefs
params.help: Бюджет входов в активном множестве соответствующего жадного алгоритма.
params.constructor_doc: Target number of non-zero coefficients. Use ``np.inf`` for no limit.

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: Sets the verbosity amount.

params.label: precompute
params.help: Заранее вычислять матрицу попарных скалярных произведений признаков для решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to use a precomputed Gram matrix to speed up calculations. If set to ``'auto'`` let us decide. The Gram matrix can also be passed as argument.

params.label: eps
params.help: Малая численная добавка для устойчивости внутренних матричных расчетов решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The machine-precision regularization in the computation of the Cholesky diagonal factors. Increase this for very ill-conditioned systems. Unlike the ``tol`` parameter in some iterative optimization-based algorithms, this parameter does not control the tolerance of the optimization.

params.label: copy_X
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: If ``True``, X will be copied; else, it may be overwritten.

params.label: fit_path
params.help: Сохранять весь путь коэффициентов LARS вместо только последнего решения.
params.constructor_doc: If True the full path is stored in the ``coef_path_`` attribute. If you compute the solution for a large problem or many targets, setting ``fit_path`` to ``False`` will lead to a speedup, especially with a small alpha.

params.label: jitter
params.help: Максимальный случайный шум, добавляемый к цели для снятия равных выборов LARS.
params.constructor_doc: Upper bound on a uniform noise parameter to be added to the `y` values, to satisfy the model's assumption of one-at-a-time computations. Might help with stability. .. versionadded:: 0.23

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Determines random number generation for jittering. Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`. Ignored if `jitter` is None. .. versionadded:: 0.23
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

algorithms.name: LassoLars
algorithms.description: Решает задачу Lasso алгоритмом LARS.
algorithms.explanation: Штраф тот же, что у Lasso, но вычисляется кусочно-линейный путь с изменением активного множества. Узлы пути не являются эпохами SGD.

params.label: alpha
params.help: Сила штрафа выбранной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Constant that multiplies the penalty term. Defaults to 1.0. ``alpha = 0`` is equivalent to an ordinary least square, solved by :class:`LinearRegression`. For numerical reasons, using ``alpha = 0`` with the LassoLars object is not advised and you should prefer the LinearRegression object.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to calculate the intercept for this model. If set to false, no intercept will be used in calculations (i.e. data is expected to be centered).

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations to perform.

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: Sets the verbosity amount.

params.label: precompute
params.help: Заранее вычислять матрицу попарных скалярных произведений признаков для решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to use a precomputed Gram matrix to speed up calculations. If set to ``'auto'`` let us decide. The Gram matrix can also be passed as argument.

params.label: eps
params.help: Малая численная добавка для устойчивости внутренних матричных расчетов решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The machine-precision regularization in the computation of the Cholesky diagonal factors. Increase this for very ill-conditioned systems. Unlike the ``tol`` parameter in some iterative optimization-based algorithms, this parameter does not control the tolerance of the optimization.

params.label: copy_X
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: If True, X will be copied; else, it may be overwritten.

params.label: fit_path
params.help: Сохранять весь путь коэффициентов LARS вместо только последнего решения.
params.constructor_doc: If ``True`` the full path is stored in the ``coef_path_`` attribute. If you compute the solution for a large problem or many targets, setting ``fit_path`` to ``False`` will lead to a speedup, especially with a small alpha.

params.label: positive
params.help: Запретить отрицательные коэффициенты поддерживающей модели.
params.constructor_doc: Restrict coefficients to be >= 0. Be aware that you might want to remove fit_intercept which is set True by default. Under the positive restriction the model coefficients will not converge to the ordinary-least-squares solution for small values of alpha. Only coefficients up to the smallest alpha value (``alphas_[alphas_ > 0.].min()`` when fit_path=True) reached by the stepwise Lars-Lasso algorithm are typically in congruence with the solution of the coordinate descent Lasso estimator.

params.label: jitter
params.help: Максимальный случайный шум, добавляемый к цели для снятия равных выборов LARS.
params.constructor_doc: Upper bound on a uniform noise parameter to be added to the `y` values, to satisfy the model's assumption of one-at-a-time computations. Might help with stability. .. versionadded:: 0.23

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Determines random number generation for jittering. Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`. Ignored if `jitter` is None. .. versionadded:: 0.23
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

algorithms.name: OrthogonalMatchingPursuit
algorithms.description: Жадно выбирает ограниченное число признаков.
algorithms.explanation: Добавляет признак, связанный с остатками, и заново решает МНК на выбранных столбцах. Это приближение выбора подмножества; глобальный оптимум L0 не гарантирован. return_path у orthogonal_mp дает настоящий путь отбора.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to calculate the intercept for this model. If set to false, no intercept will be used in calculations (i.e. data is expected to be centered).

params.label: n_nonzero_coefs
params.help: Бюджет входов в активном множестве соответствующего жадного алгоритма.
params.constructor_doc: Desired number of non-zero entries in the solution. Ignored if `tol` is set. When `None` and `tol` is also `None`, this value is either set to 10% of `n_features` or 1, whichever is greater.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum squared norm of the residual. If not None, overrides n_nonzero_coefs.

params.label: precompute
params.help: Заранее вычислять матрицу попарных скалярных произведений признаков для решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to use a precomputed Gram and Xy matrix to speed up calculations. Improves performance when :term:`n_targets` or :term:`n_samples` is very large.

algorithms.name: SGDRegressor
algorithms.description: Позволяет видеть реальные эпохи обучения.
algorithms.explanation: partial_fit выполняет одну эпоху и сохраняет счетчик обновлений. Скорость eta0 определяет размер шагов. Для квадратичной ошибки ℓ=e²/2; L2 штраф равен ‖w‖²/2. Данные желательно масштабировать.

params.label: alpha
params.help: Сила штрафа выбранной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Constant that multiplies the regularization term. The higher the value, the stronger the regularization. Also used to compute the learning rate when `learning_rate` is set to 'optimal'. Values must be in the range `[0.0, inf)`.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether the intercept should be estimated or not. If False, the data is assumed to be already centered.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The maximum number of passes over the training data (aka epochs). It only impacts the behavior in the ``fit`` method, and not the :meth:`partial_fit` method. Values must be in the range `[1, inf)`. .. versionadded:: 0.19

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The stopping criterion. If it is not None, training will stop when (loss > best_loss - tol) for ``n_iter_no_change`` consecutive epochs. Convergence is checked against the training loss or the validation loss depending on the `early_stopping` parameter. Values must be in the range `[0.0, inf)`. .. versionadded:: 0.19

params.label: l1_ratio
params.help: Доля L1 в смеси L1 и L2.
params.constructor_doc: The Elastic Net mixing parameter, with 0 <= l1_ratio <= 1. l1_ratio=0 corresponds to L2 penalty, l1_ratio=1 to L1. Only used if `penalty` is 'elasticnet'. Values must be in the range `[0.0, 1.0]` or can be `None` if `penalty` is not `elasticnet`. .. versionchanged:: 1.7 `l1_ratio` can be `None` when `penalty` is not "elasticnet".

params.label: penalty
params.help: Вид штрафа по параметрам модели.
params.constructor_doc: The penalty (aka regularization term) to be used. Defaults to 'l2' which is the standard regularizer for linear SVM models. 'l1' and 'elasticnet' might bring sparsity to the model (feature selection) not achievable with 'l2'. No penalty is added when set to `None`. You can see a visualisation of the penalties in :ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_linear_model_plot_sgd_penalties.py`.

params.label: loss
params.help: Функция, которая оценивает обучающий промах.
params.constructor_doc: The loss function to be used. The possible values are 'squared_error', 'huber', 'epsilon_insensitive', or 'squared_epsilon_insensitive' The 'squared_error' refers to the ordinary least squares fit. 'huber' modifies 'squared_error' to focus less on getting outliers correct by switching from squared to linear loss past a distance of epsilon. 'epsilon_insensitive' ignores errors less than epsilon and is linear past that; this is the loss function used in SVR. 'squared_epsilon_insensitive' is the same but becomes squared loss past a tolerance of epsilon. More details about the losses formulas can be found in the :ref:`User Guide <sgd_mathematical_formulation>`.

params.label: eta0
params.help: Начальная величина шага обновления соответствующего SGD-расписания.
params.constructor_doc: The initial learning rate for the 'constant', 'invscaling' or 'adaptive' schedules. The default value is 0.01. Values must be in the range `(0.0, inf)`. For PA-1 (`learning_rate=pa1`) and PA-II (`pa2`), it specifies the aggressiveness parameter for the passive-agressive algorithm, see [1] where it is called C: - For PA-I it is the maximum step size. - For PA-II it regularizes the step size (the smaller `eta0` the more it regularizes). As a general rule-of-thumb for PA, `eta0` should be small when the data is noisy.

params.label: learning_rate
params.help: Расписание шага обновления весов.
params.constructor_doc: The learning rate schedule: - 'constant': `eta = eta0` - 'optimal': `eta = 1.0 / (alpha * (t + t0))` where t0 is chosen by a heuristic proposed by Leon Bottou. - 'invscaling': `eta = eta0 / pow(t, power_t)` - 'adaptive': eta = eta0, as long as the training keeps decreasing. Each time n_iter_no_change consecutive epochs fail to decrease the training loss by tol or fail to increase validation score by tol if early_stopping is True, the current learning rate is divided by 5. - 'pa1': passive-aggressive algorithm 1, see [1]_. Only with `loss='epsilon_insensitive'`. Update is `w += eta y x` with `eta = min(eta0, loss/||x||**2)`. - 'pa2': passive-aggressive algorithm 2, see [1]_. Only with `loss='epsilon_insensitive'`. Update is `w += eta y x` with `eta = hinge_loss / (||x||**2 + 1/(2 eta0))`. .. versionadded:: 0.20 Added 'adaptive' option. .. versionadded:: 1.8 Added options 'pa1' and 'pa2'

params.label: epsilon
params.help: Порог соответствующей robust или epsilon-insensitive loss SGD.
params.constructor_doc: Epsilon in the epsilon-insensitive loss functions; only if `loss` is 'huber', 'epsilon_insensitive', or 'squared_epsilon_insensitive'. For 'huber', determines the threshold at which it becomes less important to get the prediction exactly right. For epsilon-insensitive, any differences between the current prediction and the correct label are ignored if they are less than this threshold. Values must be in the range `[0.0, inf)`.

params.label: shuffle
params.help: Перемешивать порядок обучающих наблюдений при поддерживающем итеративном алгоритме.
params.constructor_doc: Whether or not the training data should be shuffled after each epoch.

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: The verbosity level. Values must be in the range `[0, inf)`.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Used for shuffling the data, when ``shuffle`` is set to ``True``. Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.

params.label: power_t
params.help: Показатель степени уменьшения шага invscaling.
params.constructor_doc: The exponent for inverse scaling learning rate. Values must be in the range `[0.0, inf)`. .. deprecated:: 1.8 Negative values for `power_t` are deprecated in version 1.8 and will raise an error in 1.10. Use values in the range [0.0, inf) instead.

params.label: early_stopping
params.help: Останавливать обучение, когда внутренняя контрольная оценка перестает улучшаться.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to use early stopping to terminate training when validation score is not improving. If set to True, it will automatically set aside a fraction of training data as validation and terminate training when validation score returned by the `score` method is not improving by at least `tol` for `n_iter_no_change` consecutive epochs. See :ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_linear_model_plot_sgd_early_stopping.py` for an example of the effects of early stopping. .. versionadded:: 0.20 Added 'early_stopping' option

params.label: validation_fraction
params.help: Доля текущего обучения, выделяемая исполнителем под внутреннюю проверку.
params.constructor_doc: The proportion of training data to set aside as validation set for early stopping. Must be between 0 and 1. Only used if `early_stopping` is True. Values must be in the range `(0.0, 1.0)`. .. versionadded:: 0.20 Added 'validation_fraction' option

params.label: n_iter_no_change
params.help: Сколько последовательных проверок без достаточного улучшения разрешить до остановки.
params.constructor_doc: Number of iterations with no improvement to wait before stopping fitting. Convergence is checked against the training loss or the validation loss depending on the `early_stopping` parameter. Integer values must be in the range `[1, max_iter)`. .. versionadded:: 0.20 Added 'n_iter_no_change' option

params.label: warm_start
params.help: Переиспользовать уже обученное состояние при повторном fit того же экземпляра.
params.constructor_doc: When set to True, reuse the solution of the previous call to fit as initialization, otherwise, just erase the previous solution. See :term:`the Glossary <warm_start>`. Repeatedly calling fit or partial_fit when warm_start is True can result in a different solution than when calling fit a single time because of the way the data is shuffled. If a dynamic learning rate is used, the learning rate is adapted depending on the number of samples already seen. Calling ``fit`` resets this counter, while ``partial_fit`` will result in increasing the existing counter.

params.label: average
params.help: Усреднять накопленные веса последовательных обновлений SGD.
params.constructor_doc: When set to True, computes the averaged SGD weights across all updates and stores the result in the ``coef_`` attribute. If set to an int greater than 1, averaging will begin once the total number of samples seen reaches `average`. So ``average=10`` will begin averaging after seeing 10 samples.

algorithms.name: RANSACRegressor
algorithms.description: Ищет группу строк, согласующихся с одной моделью.
algorithms.explanation: Обучает кандидатов на случайных подмножествах, выбирает согласованный набор и переобучает модель на нем. Нет единой убывающей MSE-траектории. Показываем итоговую маску строк и число испытаний.

params.label: max_trials
params.help: Бюджет случайных испытаний RANSAC.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations for random sample selection.

params.label: residual_threshold
params.help: Порог ошибки для признания строки согласованной с моделью RANSAC.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum residual for a data sample to be classified as an inlier. By default the threshold is chosen as the MAD (median absolute deviation) of the target values `y`. Points whose residuals are strictly equal to the threshold are considered as inliers.

params.label: min_samples
params.help: Размер случайной подвыборки для одного кандидата RANSAC.
params.constructor_doc: Minimum number of samples chosen randomly from original data. Treated as an absolute number of samples for `min_samples >= 1`, treated as a relative number `ceil(min_samples * X.shape[0])` for `min_samples < 1`. This is typically chosen as the minimal number of samples necessary to estimate the given `estimator`. By default a :class:`~sklearn.linear_model.LinearRegression` estimator is assumed and `min_samples` is chosen as ``X.shape[1] + 1``. This parameter is highly dependent upon the model, so if a `estimator` other than :class:`~sklearn.linear_model.LinearRegression` is used, the user must provide a value.

params.label: estimator
params.help: Базовый алгоритм, который обучается внутри обертки или ансамбля.
params.constructor_doc: Base estimator object which implements the following methods: * `fit(X, y)`: Fit model to given training data and target values. * `score(X, y)`: Returns the mean accuracy on the given test data, which is used for the stop criterion defined by `stop_score`. Additionally, the score is used to decide which of two equally large consensus sets is chosen as the better one. * `predict(X)`: Returns predicted values using the linear model, which is used to compute residual error using loss function. If `estimator` is None, then :class:`~sklearn.linear_model.LinearRegression` is used for target values of dtype float. Note that the current implementation only supports regression estimators.

params.label: is_data_valid
params.help: Проверка допустимости случайной подвыборки или кандидата RANSAC.
params.constructor_doc: This function is called with the randomly selected data before the model is fitted to it: `is_data_valid(X, y)`. If its return value is False the current randomly chosen sub-sample is skipped.

params.label: is_model_valid
params.help: Проверка допустимости случайной подвыборки или кандидата RANSAC.
params.constructor_doc: This function is called with the estimated model and the randomly selected data: `is_model_valid(model, X, y)`. If its return value is False the current randomly chosen sub-sample is skipped. Rejecting samples with this function is computationally costlier than with `is_data_valid`. `is_model_valid` should therefore only be used if the estimated model is needed for making the rejection decision.

params.label: max_skips
params.help: Предел пропусков недопустимых случайных выборок RANSAC.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations that can be skipped due to finding zero inliers or invalid data defined by ``is_data_valid`` or invalid models defined by ``is_model_valid``. .. versionadded:: 0.19

params.label: stop_n_inliers
params.help: Завершать RANSAC после достижения заданного количества согласующихся строк.
params.constructor_doc: Stop iteration if at least this number of inliers are found.

params.label: stop_score
params.help: Остановить RANSAC, если внутренняя оценка подходящего кандидата достигла порога.
params.constructor_doc: Stop iteration if score is greater equal than this threshold.

params.label: stop_probability
params.help: Желаемая вероятность выбрать хотя бы одну чистую случайную подвыборку RANSAC.
params.constructor_doc: RANSAC iteration stops if at least one outlier-free set of the training data is sampled in RANSAC. This requires to generate at least N samples (iterations):: N >= log(1 - probability) / log(1 - e**m) where the probability (confidence) is typically set to high value such as 0.99 (the default) and e is the current fraction of inliers w.r.t. the total number of samples.

params.label: loss
params.help: Функция, которая оценивает обучающий промах.
params.constructor_doc: String inputs, 'absolute_error' and 'squared_error' are supported which find the absolute error and squared error per sample respectively. If ``loss`` is a callable, then it should be a function that takes two arrays as inputs, the true and predicted value and returns a 1-D array with the i-th value of the array corresponding to the loss on ``X[i]``. If the loss on a sample is greater than the ``residual_threshold``, then this sample is classified as an outlier. .. versionadded:: 0.18

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: The generator used to initialize the centers. Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.

algorithms.name: TheilSenRegressor
algorithms.description: Объединяет МНК по подмножествам пространственной медианой.
algorithms.explanation: Строит много оценок на подмножествах строк. Пространственная медиана дает общий итог. max_iter относится к расчету медианы, а не к проходам по датасету. Стоимость растет с числом признаков.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to calculate the intercept for this model. If set to false, no intercept will be used in calculations.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations for the calculation of spatial median.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Tolerance when calculating spatial median.

params.label: max_subpopulation
params.help: Предел кандидатов, используемых Theil–Sen.
params.constructor_doc: Instead of computing with a set of cardinality 'n choose k', where n is the number of samples and k is the number of subsamples (at least number of features), consider only a stochastic subpopulation of a given maximal size if 'n choose k' is larger than max_subpopulation. For other than small problem sizes this parameter will determine memory usage and runtime if n_subsamples is not changed. Note that the data type should be int but floats such as 1e4 can be accepted too.

params.label: n_subsamples
params.help: Размер подвыборки для одного внутреннего решения TheilSen.
params.constructor_doc: Number of samples to calculate the parameters. This is at least the number of features (plus 1 if fit_intercept=True) and the number of samples as a maximum. A lower number leads to a higher breakdown point and a low efficiency while a high number leads to a low breakdown point and a high efficiency. If None, take the minimum number of subsamples leading to maximal robustness. If n_subsamples is set to n_samples, Theil-Sen is identical to least squares.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: A random number generator instance to define the state of the random permutations generator. Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

params.label: n_jobs
params.help: Число разрешенных параллельных исполнителей.
params.constructor_doc: Number of CPUs to use during the cross validation. ``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context. ``-1`` means using all processors. See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>` for more details.

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: Verbose mode when fitting the model.

algorithms.name: HuberRegressor
algorithms.description: Мягко ограничивает влияние больших остатков.
algorithms.explanation: h(u)=u² при |u|≤ε, иначе 2ε|u|−ε². Модель одновременно оценивает масштаб σ. Это отличается от SGD с Huber, где порог задан прямо в единицах ошибки. epsilon≥1.

params.label: alpha
params.help: Сила штрафа выбранной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Strength of the squared L2 regularization. Note that the penalty is equal to ``alpha * ||w||^2``. Must be in the range `[0, inf)`.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether or not to fit the intercept. This can be set to False if the data is already centered around the origin.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations that ``scipy.optimize.minimize(method="L-BFGS-B")`` should run for.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The iteration will stop when ``max{|proj g_i | i = 1, ..., n}`` <= ``tol`` where pg_i is the i-th component of the projected gradient.

params.label: epsilon
params.help: Порог стандартизованного остатка Huber.
params.constructor_doc: The parameter epsilon controls the number of samples that should be classified as outliers. The smaller the epsilon, the more robust it is to outliers. Epsilon must be in the range `[1, inf)`.

params.label: warm_start
params.help: Переиспользовать уже обученное состояние при повторном fit того же экземпляра.
params.constructor_doc: This is useful if the stored attributes of a previously used model has to be reused. If set to False, then the coefficients will be rewritten for every call to fit. See :term:`the Glossary <warm_start>`.

algorithms.name: BayesianRidge
algorithms.description: Оценивает коэффициенты и их неопределенность.
algorithms.explanation: Шум и сила сжатия оцениваются по данным. compute_score сохраняет логарифм маргинального правдоподобия, который максимизируется. alpha здесь означает точность шума, а не ручную силу штрафа Ridge.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to calculate the intercept for this model. The intercept is not treated as a probabilistic parameter and thus has no associated variance. If set to False, no intercept will be used in calculations (i.e. data is expected to be centered).

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations over the complete dataset before stopping independently of any early stopping criterion. .. versionchanged:: 1.3

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Stop the algorithm if w has converged.

params.label: alpha_1
params.help: Параметры Gamma-prior для точности шума в BayesianRidge и ARD.
params.constructor_doc: Hyper-parameter : shape parameter for the Gamma distribution prior over the alpha parameter.

params.label: alpha_2
params.help: Параметры Gamma-prior для точности шума в BayesianRidge и ARD.
params.constructor_doc: Hyper-parameter : inverse scale parameter (rate parameter) for the Gamma distribution prior over the alpha parameter.

params.label: lambda_1
params.help: Параметры Gamma-prior для точности коэффициентов байесовской линейной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Hyper-parameter : shape parameter for the Gamma distribution prior over the lambda parameter.

params.label: lambda_2
params.help: Параметры Gamma-prior для точности коэффициентов байесовской линейной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Hyper-parameter : inverse scale parameter (rate parameter) for the Gamma distribution prior over the lambda parameter.

params.label: alpha_init
params.help: Начальная точность шума байесовской линейной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Initial value for alpha (precision of the noise). If not set, alpha_init is 1/Var(y). .. versionadded:: 0.22

params.label: lambda_init
params.help: Начальная точность распределения коэффициентов BayesianRidge.
params.constructor_doc: Initial value for lambda (precision of the weights). If not set, lambda_init is 1. .. versionadded:: 0.22

params.label: compute_score
params.help: Сохранять значения логарифма маргинального правдоподобия на итерациях.
params.constructor_doc: If True, compute the log marginal likelihood at each iteration of the optimization.

params.label: copy_X
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: If True, X will be copied; else, it may be overwritten.

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: Verbose mode when fitting the model.

algorithms.name: ARDRegression
algorithms.description: Каждый признак получает собственную силу сжатия.
algorithms.explanation: Высокая точность λ_j означает маленькую дисперсию коэффициента. Сильно подавленные признаки удаляются по threshold_lambda. scores_ — целевая функция для максимизации, не MSE.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to calculate the intercept for this model. If set to false, no intercept will be used in calculations (i.e. data is expected to be centered).

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations. .. versionchanged:: 1.3

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Stop the algorithm if w has converged.

params.label: threshold_lambda
params.help: Порог точности коэффициента для удаления входа ARD.
params.constructor_doc: Threshold for removing (pruning) weights with high precision from the computation.

params.label: alpha_1
params.help: Параметры Gamma-prior для точности шума в BayesianRidge и ARD.
params.constructor_doc: Hyper-parameter : shape parameter for the Gamma distribution prior over the alpha parameter.

params.label: alpha_2
params.help: Параметры Gamma-prior для точности шума в BayesianRidge и ARD.
params.constructor_doc: Hyper-parameter : inverse scale parameter (rate parameter) for the Gamma distribution prior over the alpha parameter.

params.label: lambda_1
params.help: Параметры Gamma-prior для точности коэффициентов байесовской линейной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Hyper-parameter : shape parameter for the Gamma distribution prior over the lambda parameter.

params.label: lambda_2
params.help: Параметры Gamma-prior для точности коэффициентов байесовской линейной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Hyper-parameter : inverse scale parameter (rate parameter) for the Gamma distribution prior over the lambda parameter.

params.label: compute_score
params.help: Сохранять значения логарифма маргинального правдоподобия на итерациях.
params.constructor_doc: If True, compute the objective function at each step of the model.

params.label: copy_X
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: If True, X will be copied; else, it may be overwritten.

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: Verbose mode when fitting the model.

algorithms.name: QuantileRegressor
algorithms.description: Предсказывает выбранный условный квантиль.
algorithms.explanation: q=0.5 предсказывает медиану. q=0.9 описывает верхнюю границу для большинства наблюдений при подходящей модели. Обучается через линейное программирование HiGHS; промежуточные коэффициенты не доступны.

params.label: alpha
params.help: Сила штрафа выбранной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Regularization constant that multiplies the L1 penalty term.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether or not to fit the intercept.

params.label: quantile
params.help: Уровень условной квантили числового ответа.
params.constructor_doc: The quantile that the model tries to predict. It must be strictly between 0 and 1. If 0.5 (default), the model predicts the 50% quantile, i.e. the median.

params.label: solver
params.help: Алгоритм, который подбирает внутренние параметры модели.
params.constructor_doc: Method used by :func:`scipy.optimize.linprog` to solve the linear programming formulation. It is recommended to use the highs methods because they are the fastest ones. Solvers "highs-ds", "highs-ipm" and "highs" support sparse input data and, in fact, always convert to sparse csc. From `scipy>=1.11.0`, "interior-point" is not available anymore. .. versionchanged:: 1.4 The default of `solver` changed to `"highs"` in version 1.4.

params.label: solver_options
params.help: Дополнительные именованные настройки численного решателя QuantileRegressor.
params.constructor_doc: Additional parameters passed to :func:`scipy.optimize.linprog` as options. If `None` and if `solver='interior-point'`, then `{"lstsq": True}` is passed to :func:`scipy.optimize.linprog` for the sake of stability.

algorithms.name: PoissonRegressor
algorithms.description: Модель неотрицательных величин со связью exp.
algorithms.explanation: Все y должны быть ≥0; целые значения не обязательны. Предсказания положительные. По коэффициентам модель линейна до применения экспоненты, поэтому график предсказаний обычно не является плоскостью.

params.label: alpha
params.help: Сила штрафа выбранной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Constant that multiplies the L2 penalty term and determines the regularization strength. ``alpha = 0`` is equivalent to unpenalized GLMs. In this case, the design matrix `X` must have full column rank (no collinearities). Values of `alpha` must be in the range `[0.0, inf)`.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Specifies if a constant (a.k.a. bias or intercept) should be added to the linear predictor (`X @ coef + intercept`).

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The maximal number of iterations for the solver. Values must be in the range `[1, inf)`.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Stopping criterion. For the lbfgs solver, the iteration will stop when ``max{|g_j|, j = 1, ..., d} <= tol`` where ``g_j`` is the j-th component of the gradient (derivative) of the objective function. Values must be in the range `(0.0, inf)`.

params.label: solver
params.help: Алгоритм, который подбирает внутренние параметры модели.
params.constructor_doc: Algorithm to use in the optimization problem: 'lbfgs' Calls scipy's L-BFGS-B optimizer. 'newton-cholesky' Uses Newton-Raphson steps (in arbitrary precision arithmetic equivalent to iterated reweighted least squares) with an inner Cholesky based solver. This solver is a good choice for `n_samples` >> `n_features`, especially with one-hot encoded categorical features with rare categories. Be aware that the memory usage of this solver has a quadratic dependency on `n_features` because it explicitly computes the Hessian matrix. .. versionadded:: 1.2

params.label: warm_start
params.help: Переиспользовать уже обученное состояние при повторном fit того же экземпляра.
params.constructor_doc: If set to ``True``, reuse the solution of the previous call to ``fit`` as initialization for ``coef_`` and ``intercept_`` .

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: For the lbfgs solver set verbose to any positive number for verbosity. Values must be in the range `[0, inf)`.

algorithms.name: GammaRegressor
algorithms.description: Модель строго положительных величин со связью exp.
algorithms.explanation: Все y должны быть >0. Нули и отрицательные значения недопустимы. Дисперсия Gamma растет с квадратом среднего; связь по умолчанию логарифмическая.

params.label: alpha
params.help: Сила штрафа выбранной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Constant that multiplies the L2 penalty term and determines the regularization strength. ``alpha = 0`` is equivalent to unpenalized GLMs. In this case, the design matrix `X` must have full column rank (no collinearities). Values of `alpha` must be in the range `[0.0, inf)`.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Specifies if a constant (a.k.a. bias or intercept) should be added to the linear predictor `X @ coef_ + intercept_`.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The maximal number of iterations for the solver. Values must be in the range `[1, inf)`.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Stopping criterion. For the lbfgs solver, the iteration will stop when ``max{|g_j|, j = 1, ..., d} <= tol`` where ``g_j`` is the j-th component of the gradient (derivative) of the objective function. Values must be in the range `(0.0, inf)`.

algorithms.description: Выбирает семейство ошибки через степень дисперсии.
algorithms.explanation: p=0: нормальная ошибка; p=1: Пуассон, y≥0; 1<p<2: y≥0; p≥2: y>0. Значения 0<p<1 недопустимы. link=auto использует тождественную связь при p≤0 и log при p>0.

params.help: Параметр семейства Tweedie, задающий форму дисперсии и допустимую цель.

Option 'auto' sets the link depending on the chosen `power` parameter as follows: - 'identity' for ``power <= 0``, e.g. for the Normal distribution - 'log' for ``power > 0``, e.g. for Poisson, Gamma and Inverse Gaussian distributions

algorithms.name: LinearSVR
algorithms.description: Игнорирует ошибки внутри полосы ε.
algorithms.explanation: LIBLINEAR штрафует также искусственный коэффициент свободного члена (intercept_scaling=1). C задает цену ошибок: увеличение C ослабляет относительное влияние регуляризации. Для squared_epsilon_insensitive ошибка в формуле возводится в квадрат.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether or not to fit an intercept. If set to True, the feature vector is extended to include an intercept term: `[x_1, ..., x_n, 1]`, where 1 corresponds to the intercept. If set to False, no intercept will be used in calculations (i.e. data is expected to be already centered).

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The maximum number of iterations to be run.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Tolerance for stopping criteria.

params.label: C
params.help: Обратная сила регуляризации: меньше C — сильнее ограничение модели.
params.constructor_doc: Regularization parameter. The strength of the regularization is inversely proportional to C. Must be strictly positive.

params.label: epsilon
params.help: Ширина полосы ошибок без соответствующего штрафа у SVR.
params.constructor_doc: Epsilon parameter in the epsilon-insensitive loss function. Note that the value of this parameter depends on the scale of the target variable y. If unsure, set ``epsilon=0``.

params.label: loss
params.help: Функция, которая оценивает обучающий промах.
params.constructor_doc: Specifies the loss function. The epsilon-insensitive loss (standard SVR) is the L1 loss, while the squared epsilon-insensitive loss ('squared_epsilon_insensitive') is the L2 loss.

params.label: intercept_scaling
params.help: Масштаб искусственного признака для свободного члена поддерживающего линейного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: When `fit_intercept` is True, the instance vector x becomes `[x_1, ..., x_n, intercept_scaling]`, i.e. a "synthetic" feature with a constant value equal to `intercept_scaling` is appended to the instance vector. The intercept becomes intercept_scaling * synthetic feature weight. Note that liblinear internally penalizes the intercept, treating it like any other term in the feature vector. To reduce the impact of the regularization on the intercept, the `intercept_scaling` parameter can be set to a value greater than 1; the higher the value of `intercept_scaling`, the lower the impact of regularization on it. Then, the weights become `[w_x_1, ..., w_x_n, w_intercept*intercept_scaling]`, where `w_x_1, ..., w_x_n` represent the feature weights and the intercept weight is scaled by `intercept_scaling`. This scaling allows the intercept term to have a different regularization behavior compared to the other features.

params.label: dual
params.help: Выбирать двойственную постановку вместо прямой в поддерживающей линейной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Select the algorithm to either solve the dual or primal optimization problem. Prefer dual=False when n_samples > n_features. `dual="auto"` will choose the value of the parameter automatically, based on the values of `n_samples`, `n_features` and `loss`. If `n_samples` < `n_features` and optimizer supports chosen `loss`, then dual will be set to True, otherwise it will be set to False. .. versionchanged:: 1.3 The `"auto"` option is added in version 1.3 and will be the default in version 1.5.

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: Enable verbose output. Note that this setting takes advantage of a per-process runtime setting in liblinear that, if enabled, may not work properly in a multithreaded context.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Controls the pseudo random number generation for shuffling the data. Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

algorithms.name: LinearRegression
algorithms.description: Запрещает отрицательные коэффициенты.
algorithms.explanation: Ограничивается знак коэффициентов. Значения y и свободный член могут быть отрицательными. Реализация scipy NNLS через sklearn LinearRegression(positive=True).

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to calculate the intercept for this model. If set to False, no intercept will be used in calculations (i.e. data is expected to be centered).

params.label: copy_X
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: If True, X will be copied; else, it may be overwritten.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The precision of the solution (`coef_`) is determined by `tol` which specifies a different convergence criterion for the `lsqr` solver. `tol` is set as `atol` and `btol` of :func:`scipy.sparse.linalg.lsqr` when fitting on sparse training data. This parameter has no effect when fitting on dense data. .. versionadded:: 1.7

params.label: n_jobs
params.help: Число разрешенных параллельных исполнителей.
params.constructor_doc: The number of jobs to use for the computation. This will only provide speedup in case of sufficiently large problems, that is if firstly `n_targets > 1` and secondly `X` is sparse or if `positive` is set to `True`. ``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context. ``-1`` means using all processors. See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>` for more details.

params.label: positive
params.help: Запретить отрицательные коэффициенты поддерживающей модели.
params.constructor_doc: When set to ``True``, forces the coefficients to be positive. This option is only supported for dense arrays. For a comparison between a linear regression model with positive constraints on the regression coefficients and a linear regression without such constraints, see :ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_linear_model_plot_nnls.py`. .. versionadded:: 0.24

algorithms.name: WeightedLassoRegressor
algorithms.description: Штрафует признаки с разной силой.
algorithms.explanation: Профиль задает веса в порядке преобразованных признаков: от 1 до weight_ratio либо в обратном порядке. Это явная настройка весов; Adaptive Lasso получает веса из обучающих данных.

algorithms.name: AdaptiveLassoRegressor
algorithms.description: Определяет разные веса штрафа по первичной оценке.
algorithms.explanation: Сначала Ridge обучается на той же обучающей части. Затем маленькие первичные коэффициенты получают более сильный штраф. epsilon делает веса конечными: это явно указанная численная стабилизация исходного Adaptive Lasso.

algorithms.explanation: Соседние преобразованные столбцы образуют группы заданного размера. Вес √|g| учитывает размер группы. Отдельные коэффициенты внутри оставшейся группы не обязаны быть нулевыми.

algorithms.explanation: L1 обнуляет отдельные признаки; групповой штраф способен обнулить сразу группу. r=1 дает Lasso; r=0 дает Group Lasso. Группы определяются порядком преобразованных столбцов.

algorithms.description: Сжимает коэффициенты и сближает соседние.

algorithms.description: Штрафует выбранное линейное преобразование коэффициентов.

algorithms.name: BestSubsetRegressor

algorithms.explanation: ‖w‖₀ — число ненулевых коэффициентов. Для каждого подмножества библиотечный SVD решает МНК. Глобальное решение в этом ограниченном пространстве получается перебором, с обычной погрешностью чисел. До 4096 подмножеств; полиномиальные признаки тоже входят в предел 12.

algorithms.explanation: Точная нормировка skglm SqrtLasso: ‖e‖₂ без деления на √n. Для записи ‖e‖₂/√n+λ‖w‖₁ нужно alpha=√n·λ. API библиотеки экспериментальный; промежуточные коэффициенты fit не доступны.

params.label: tol

params.constructor_doc: Tolerance for convergence.

params.label: max_pn_iter

params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of prox Newton iterations on each subproblem.

params.label: p0
params.help: Начальное число признаков в активном рабочем наборе координатного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Minimum number of features to be included in the working set.

params.label: verbose

algorithms.name: DecisionTreeRegressor
algorithms.description: Разделяет строки по условиям на признаки. В каждом листе хранит итоговый ответ.

params.label: max_depth
params.help: Максимальное число последовательных разделений на пути дерева.
params.constructor_doc: The maximum depth of the tree. If None, then nodes are expanded until all leaves are pure or until all leaves contain less than min_samples_split samples. For an example of how ``max_depth`` influences the model, see :ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_tree_plot_tree_regression.py`.

params.label: min_samples_leaf
params.help: Минимальное количество обучающих строк в одном листе.
params.constructor_doc: The minimum number of samples required to be at a leaf node. A split point at any depth will only be considered if it leaves at least ``min_samples_leaf`` training samples in each of the left and right branches. This may have the effect of smoothing the model, especially in regression. - If int, then consider `min_samples_leaf` as the minimum number. - If float, then `min_samples_leaf` is a fraction and `ceil(min_samples_leaf * n_samples)` are the minimum number of samples for each node. .. versionchanged:: 0.18 Added float values for fractions.

params.label: min_samples_split
params.help: Сколько строк должен иметь узел, чтобы его разрешили разделить.
params.constructor_doc: The minimum number of samples required to split an internal node: - If int, then consider `min_samples_split` as the minimum number. - If float, then `min_samples_split` is a fraction and `ceil(min_samples_split * n_samples)` are the minimum number of samples for each split. .. versionchanged:: 0.18 Added float values for fractions.

params.label: criterion
params.help: Правило оценки кандидата на разделение дерева.
params.constructor_doc: The function to measure the quality of a split. Supported criteria are "squared_error" for the mean squared error, which is equal to variance reduction as feature selection criterion and minimizes the L2 loss using the mean of each terminal node, "friedman_mse", which uses mean squared error with Friedman's improvement score for potential splits, "absolute_error" for the mean absolute error, which minimizes the L1 loss using the median of each terminal node, and "poisson" which uses reduction in the half mean Poisson deviance to find splits. .. versionadded:: 0.18 Mean Absolute Error (MAE) criterion. .. versionadded:: 0.24 Poisson deviance criterion.

params.label: splitter
params.help: Как дерево выбирает кандидат разделения в текущем узле.
params.constructor_doc: The strategy used to choose the split at each node. Supported strategies are "best" to choose the best split and "random" to choose the best random split.

params.label: min_weight_fraction_leaf
params.help: Минимальная доля суммарного веса обучающих строк в каждом листе дерева.
params.constructor_doc: The minimum weighted fraction of the sum total of weights (of all the input samples) required to be at a leaf node. Samples have equal weight when sample_weight is not provided.

params.label: max_features
params.help: Сколько входных признаков рассматривается при поиске разделения или сохраняется отбором.
params.constructor_doc: The number of features to consider when looking for the best split: - If int, then consider `max_features` features at each split. - If float, then `max_features` is a fraction and `max(1, int(max_features * n_features_in_))` features are considered at each split. - If "sqrt", then `max_features=sqrt(n_features)`. - If "log2", then `max_features=log2(n_features)`. - If None, then `max_features=n_features`. Note: the search for a split does not stop until at least one valid partition of the node samples is found, even if it requires to effectively inspect more than ``max_features`` features.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Controls the randomness of the estimator. The features are always randomly permuted at each split, even if ``splitter`` is set to ``"best"``. When ``max_features < n_features``, the algorithm will select ``max_features`` at random at each split before finding the best split among them. But the best found split may vary across different runs, even if ``max_features=n_features``. That is the case, if the improvement of the criterion is identical for several splits and one split has to be selected at random. To obtain a deterministic behaviour during fitting, ``random_state`` has to be fixed to an integer. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>` for details.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

params.label: max_leaf_nodes
params.help: max_leaf_nodes ограничивает число конечных листьев дерева.
params.constructor_doc: Grow a tree with ``max_leaf_nodes`` in best-first fashion. Best nodes are defined as relative reduction in impurity. If None then unlimited number of leaf nodes.

params.label: min_impurity_decrease
params.help: Минимальный выигрыш от разделения, необходимый для его выполнения.
params.constructor_doc: A node will be split if this split induces a decrease of the impurity greater than or equal to this value. The weighted impurity decrease equation is the following:: N_t / N * (impurity - N_t_R / N_t * right_impurity - N_t_L / N_t * left_impurity) where ``N`` is the total number of samples, ``N_t`` is the number of samples at the current node, ``N_t_L`` is the number of samples in the left child, and ``N_t_R`` is the number of samples in the right child. ``N``, ``N_t``, ``N_t_R`` and ``N_t_L`` all refer to the weighted sum, if ``sample_weight`` is passed. .. versionadded:: 0.19

params.label: ccp_alpha
params.help: Цена сложности при обрезке дерева.
params.constructor_doc: Complexity parameter used for Minimal Cost-Complexity Pruning. The subtree with the largest cost complexity that is smaller than ``ccp_alpha`` will be chosen. By default, no pruning is performed. See :ref:`minimal_cost_complexity_pruning` for details. See :ref:`sphx_glr_auto_examples_tree_plot_cost_complexity_pruning.py` for an example of such pruning. .. versionadded:: 0.22

params.label: monotonic_cst
params.help: Ограничивать направление изменения прогноза при увеличении выбранного признака.
params.constructor_doc: Indicates the monotonicity constraint to enforce on each feature. - 1: monotonic increase - 0: no constraint - -1: monotonic decrease If monotonic_cst is None, no constraints are applied. Monotonicity constraints are not supported for: - multioutput regressions (i.e. when `n_outputs_ > 1`), - regressions trained on data with missing values. Read more in the :ref:`User Guide <monotonic_cst_gbdt>`. .. versionadded:: 1.4
params.documented_type: array-like of int of shape (n_features), default=None

params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.

params.constructor_doc: When set to ``True``, reuse the solution of the previous call to fit and add more estimators to the ensemble, otherwise, just fit a whole new forest. See :term:`Glossary <warm_start>` and :ref:`tree_ensemble_warm_start` for details.

params.label: ccp_alpha
params.help: Цена сложности при обрезке дерева.

params.label: max_samples
params.help: Бюджет строк для одного компонента ансамбля.
params.constructor_doc: If bootstrap is True, the number of samples to draw from X to train each base estimator. - If None (default), then draw `X.shape[0]` samples. - If int, then draw `max_samples` samples. - If float, then draw `max(round(n_samples * max_samples), 1)` samples. Thus, `max_samples` should be in the interval `(0.0, 1.0]`. .. versionadded:: 0.22
