params.constructor_doc: The convergence threshold. EM iterations will stop when the lower bound average gain on the likelihood (of the training data with respect to the model) is below this threshold.

params.label: reg_covar
params.help: Стабилизирующая добавка к диагонали ковариации смеси.
params.constructor_doc: Non-negative regularization added to the diagonal of covariance. Allows to assure that the covariance matrices are all positive.

params.label: n_init
params.help: Число начальных попыток соответствующего алгоритма.
params.constructor_doc: The number of initializations to perform. The result with the highest lower bound value on the likelihood is kept.

params.label: init_params
params.help: Способ получить начальное состояние вероятностной смеси.
params.constructor_doc: The method used to initialize the weights, the means and the covariances. String must be one of: - 'kmeans': responsibilities are initialized using kmeans. - 'k-means++': use the k-means++ method to initialize. - 'random': responsibilities are initialized randomly. - 'random_from_data': initial means are randomly selected data points. .. versionchanged:: v1.1 `init_params` now accepts 'random_from_data' and 'k-means++' as initialization methods.

params.label: weight_concentration_prior_type
params.help: Тип prior весов BayesianGaussianMixture.
params.constructor_doc: String describing the type of the weight concentration prior.

params.label: weight_concentration_prior
params.help: Концентрация prior весов BayesianGaussianMixture.
params.constructor_doc: The dirichlet concentration of each component on the weight distribution (Dirichlet). This is commonly called gamma in the literature. The higher concentration puts more mass in the center and will lead to more components being active, while a lower concentration parameter will lead to more mass at the edge of the mixture weights simplex. The value of the parameter must be greater than 0. If it is None, it's set to ``1. / n_components``.

params.label: mean_precision_prior
params.help: Точность prior положения средних компонентов смеси.
params.constructor_doc: The precision prior on the mean distribution (Gaussian). Controls the extent of where means can be placed. Larger values concentrate the cluster means around `mean_prior`. The value of the parameter must be greater than 0. If it is None, it is set to 1.

params.label: mean_prior
params.help: Предварительный центр средних компонентов BayesianGaussianMixture.
params.constructor_doc: The prior on the mean distribution (Gaussian). If it is None, it is set to the mean of X.

params.label: degrees_of_freedom_prior
params.help: Число степеней свободы prior ковариации вероятностной смеси.
params.constructor_doc: The prior of the number of degrees of freedom on the covariance distributions (Wishart). If it is None, it's set to `n_features`.

params.label: covariance_prior
params.help: Предварительная ковариационная структура BayesianGaussianMixture.
params.constructor_doc: The prior on the covariance distribution (Wishart). If it is None, the emiprical covariance prior is initialized using the covariance of X. The shape depends on `covariance_type`:: (n_features, n_features) if 'full', (n_features, n_features) if 'tied', (n_features) if 'diag', float if 'spherical'

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Controls the random seed given to the method chosen to initialize the parameters (see `init_params`). In addition, it controls the generation of random samples from the fitted distribution (see the method `sample`). Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

params.label: warm_start
params.help: Переиспользовать уже обученное состояние при повторном fit того же экземпляра.
params.constructor_doc: If 'warm_start' is True, the solution of the last fitting is used as initialization for the next call of fit(). This can speed up convergence when fit is called several times on similar problems. See :term:`the Glossary <warm_start>`.

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: Enable verbose output. If 1 then it prints the current initialization and each iteration step. If greater than 1 then it prints also the log probability and the time needed for each step.

params.label: verbose_interval
params.help: Частота вывода диагностических сообщений или метрик исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: Number of iteration done before the next print.

algorithms.name: IsolationForest
algorithms.description: Редкую строку удается изолировать меньшим числом случайных разделений.

params.label: contamination
params.help: Ожидаемая доля для настройки порога аномалий.
params.constructor_doc: The amount of contamination of the data set, i.e. the proportion of outliers in the data set. Used when fitting to define the threshold on the scores of the samples. - If 'auto', the threshold is determined as in the original paper. - If float, the contamination should be in the range (0, 0.5]. .. versionchanged:: 0.22 The default value of ``contamination`` changed from 0.1 to ``'auto'``.

params.label: n_estimators
params.help: Количество обучаемых компонентов, обычно деревьев.
params.constructor_doc: The number of base estimators in the ensemble.

params.label: max_samples
params.help: Бюджет строк для одного компонента ансамбля.
params.constructor_doc: The number of samples to draw from X to train each base estimator. - If int, then draw `max_samples` samples. - If float, then draw `max_samples * X.shape[0]` samples. - If "auto", then `max_samples=min(256, n_samples)`. If max_samples is larger than the number of samples provided, all samples will be used for all trees (no sampling).

params.label: max_features
params.help: Сколько входных признаков рассматривается при поиске разделения или сохраняется отбором.
params.constructor_doc: The number of features to draw from X to train each base estimator. - If int, then draw `max_features` features. - If float, then draw `max(1, int(max_features * n_features_in_))` features. Note: using a float number less than 1.0 or integer less than number of features will enable feature subsampling and leads to a longer runtime.

params.label: bootstrap
params.help: Обучать компоненты на выборках строк с возвращением.
params.constructor_doc: If True, individual trees are fit on random subsets of the training data sampled with replacement. If False, sampling without replacement is performed.

params.label: n_jobs
params.help: Число разрешенных параллельных исполнителей.
params.constructor_doc: The number of jobs to run in parallel for :meth:`fit`. ``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context. ``-1`` means using all processors. See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>` for more details.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Controls the pseudo-randomness of the selection of the feature and split values for each branching step and each tree in the forest. Pass an int for reproducible results across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: Controls the verbosity of the tree building process.

params.label: warm_start
params.help: Переиспользовать уже обученное состояние при повторном fit того же экземпляра.
params.constructor_doc: When set to ``True``, reuse the solution of the previous call to fit and add more estimators to the ensemble, otherwise, just fit a whole new forest. See :term:`the Glossary <warm_start>`. .. versionadded:: 0.21

algorithms.name: LocalOutlierFactor
algorithms.description: Сравнивает плотность около строки с плотностью около ее соседей.

params.label: contamination
params.help: Ожидаемая доля для настройки порога аномалий.
params.constructor_doc: The amount of contamination of the data set, i.e. the proportion of outliers in the data set. When fitting this is used to define the threshold on the scores of the samples. - if 'auto', the threshold is determined as in the original paper, - if a float, the contamination should be in the range (0, 0.5]. .. versionchanged:: 0.22 The default value of ``contamination`` changed from 0.1 to ``'auto'``.

params.label: n_neighbors
params.help: Число соседей, используемых для прогноза или построения локального графа.
params.constructor_doc: Number of neighbors to use by default for :meth:`kneighbors` queries. If n_neighbors is larger than the number of samples provided, all samples will be used.

params.label: algorithm
params.help: Вычислительный вариант конкретного алгоритма.
params.constructor_doc: Algorithm used to compute the nearest neighbors: - 'ball_tree' will use :class:`BallTree` - 'kd_tree' will use :class:`KDTree` - 'brute' will use a brute-force search. - 'auto' will attempt to decide the most appropriate algorithm based on the values passed to :meth:`fit` method. Note: fitting on sparse input will override the setting of this parameter, using brute force.

params.label: leaf_size
params.help: Размер листа дерева индекса соседей.
params.constructor_doc: Leaf is size passed to :class:`BallTree` or :class:`KDTree`. This can affect the speed of the construction and query, as well as the memory required to store the tree. The optimal value depends on the nature of the problem.

params.label: metric
params.help: Правило измерения расстояния или сходства, если поле принадлежит алгоритму.
params.constructor_doc: Metric to use for distance computation. Default is "minkowski", which results in the standard Euclidean distance when p = 2. See the documentation of `scipy.spatial.distance <https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/spatial.distance.html>`_ and the metrics listed in :class:`~sklearn.metrics.pairwise.distance_metrics` for valid metric values. If metric is "precomputed", X is assumed to be a distance matrix and must be square during fit. X may be a :term:`sparse graph`, in which case only "nonzero" elements may be considered neighbors. If metric is a callable function, it takes two arrays representing 1D vectors as inputs and must return one value indicating the distance between those vectors. This works for Scipy's metrics, but is less efficient than passing the metric name as a string.

params.label: p
params.help: Степень в расстоянии Минковского для подходящего метода соседей.
params.constructor_doc: Parameter for the Minkowski metric from :func:`sklearn.metrics.pairwise_distances`. When p = 1, this is equivalent to using manhattan_distance (l1), and euclidean_distance (l2) for p = 2. For arbitrary p, minkowski_distance (l_p) is used.

params.label: metric_params
params.help: Дополнительные именованные настройки функции расстояния.
params.constructor_doc: Additional keyword arguments for the metric function.

params.label: novelty
params.help: Режим прогнозирования необычности новых объектов у LOF.
params.constructor_doc: By default, LocalOutlierFactor is only meant to be used for outlier detection (novelty=False). Set novelty to True if you want to use LocalOutlierFactor for novelty detection. In this case be aware that you should only use predict, decision_function and score_samples on new unseen data and not on the training set; and note that the results obtained this way may differ from the standard LOF results. .. versionadded:: 0.20

params.label: n_jobs
params.help: Число разрешенных параллельных исполнителей.
params.constructor_doc: The number of parallel jobs to run for neighbors search. ``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context. ``-1`` means using all processors. See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>` for more details.

algorithms.name: OneClassSVM
algorithms.description: Определяет область типичных обучающих строк.

params.label: nu
params.help: Параметр nu у соответствующей модели опорных векторов.
params.constructor_doc: An upper bound on the fraction of training errors and a lower bound of the fraction of support vectors. Should be in the interval (0, 1]. By default 0.5 will be taken.

params.label: kernel
params.help: Функция сравнения строк для ядерной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Specifies the kernel type to be used in the algorithm. If none is given, 'rbf' will be used. If a callable is given it is used to precompute the kernel matrix.

params.label: degree
params.help: Степень полинома в преобразовании или полиномиальном ядре.
params.constructor_doc: Degree of the polynomial kernel function ('poly'). Must be non-negative. Ignored by all other kernels.

params.label: gamma
params.help: Локальность влияния точки в подходящем ядре.
params.constructor_doc: Kernel coefficient for 'rbf', 'poly' and 'sigmoid'. - if ``gamma='scale'`` (default) is passed then it uses 1 / (n_features * X.var()) as value of gamma, - if 'auto', uses 1 / n_features - if float, must be non-negative. .. versionchanged:: 0.22 The default value of ``gamma`` changed from 'auto' to 'scale'.

params.label: coef0
params.help: Свободная константа внутри полиномиального или sigmoid-ядра.
params.constructor_doc: Independent term in kernel function. It is only significant in 'poly' and 'sigmoid'.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Tolerance for stopping criterion.

params.label: shrinking
params.help: Использовать эвристику временного исключения неактивных переменных SVM.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to use the shrinking heuristic. See the :ref:`User Guide <shrinking_svm>`.

params.label: cache_size
params.help: Предел кеша значений ядра SVM в мегабайтах.
params.constructor_doc: Specify the size of the kernel cache (in MB).

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: Enable verbose output. Note that this setting takes advantage of a per-process runtime setting in libsvm that, if enabled, may not work properly in a multithreaded context.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Hard limit on iterations within solver, or -1 for no limit.

algorithms.name: SGDOneClassSVM
algorithms.description: Обучает линейную область типичных строк небольшими обновлениями.

params.label: nu
params.help: Параметр nu у соответствующей модели опорных векторов.
params.constructor_doc: The nu parameter of the One Class SVM: an upper bound on the fraction of training errors and a lower bound of the fraction of support vectors. Should be in the interval (0, 1]. By default 0.5 will be taken.

params.label: fit_intercept
params.help: Добавлять обучаемый свободный член.
params.constructor_doc: Whether the intercept should be estimated or not. Defaults to True.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The maximum number of passes over the training data (aka epochs). It only impacts the behavior in the ``fit`` method, and not the `partial_fit`. Defaults to 1000. Values must be in the range `[1, inf)`.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: The stopping criterion. If it is not None, the iterations will stop when (loss > previous_loss - tol). Defaults to 1e-3. Values must be in the range `[0.0, inf)`.

params.label: shuffle
params.help: Перемешивать порядок обучающих наблюдений при поддерживающем итеративном алгоритме.
params.constructor_doc: Whether or not the training data should be shuffled after each epoch. Defaults to True.

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: The verbosity level.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: The seed of the pseudo random number generator to use when shuffling the data. If int, random_state is the seed used by the random number generator; If RandomState instance, random_state is the random number generator; If None, the random number generator is the RandomState instance used by `np.random`.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

params.label: learning_rate
params.help: Расписание шага обновления весов.
params.constructor_doc: The learning rate schedule to use with `fit`. (If using `partial_fit`, learning rate must be controlled directly). - 'constant': `eta = eta0` - 'optimal': `eta = 1.0 / (alpha * (t + t0))` where t0 is chosen by a heuristic proposed by Leon Bottou. - 'invscaling': `eta = eta0 / pow(t, power_t)` - 'adaptive': eta = eta0, as long as the training keeps decreasing. Each time n_iter_no_change consecutive epochs fail to decrease the training loss by tol or fail to increase validation score by tol if early_stopping is True, the current learning rate is divided by 5.

params.label: eta0
params.help: Начальная величина шага обновления соответствующего SGD-расписания.
params.constructor_doc: The initial learning rate for the 'constant', 'invscaling' or 'adaptive' schedules. The default value is 0.0, but note that eta0 is not used by the default learning rate 'optimal'. Values must be in the range `(0.0, inf)`.

params.label: power_t
params.help: Показатель степени уменьшения шага invscaling.
params.constructor_doc: The exponent for inverse scaling learning rate. Values must be in the range `[0.0, inf)`. .. deprecated:: 1.8 Negative values for `power_t` are deprecated in version 1.8 and will raise an error in 1.10. Use values in the range [0.0, inf) instead.

params.label: warm_start
params.help: Переиспользовать уже обученное состояние при повторном fit того же экземпляра.
params.constructor_doc: When set to True, reuse the solution of the previous call to fit as initialization, otherwise, just erase the previous solution. See :term:`the Glossary <warm_start>`. Repeatedly calling fit or partial_fit when warm_start is True can result in a different solution than when calling fit a single time because of the way the data is shuffled. If a dynamic learning rate is used, the learning rate is adapted depending on the number of samples already seen. Calling ``fit`` resets this counter, while ``partial_fit`` will result in increasing the existing counter.

params.label: average
params.help: Усреднять накопленные веса последовательных обновлений SGD.
params.constructor_doc: When set to True, computes the averaged SGD weights and stores the result in the ``coef_`` attribute. If set to an int greater than 1, averaging will begin once the total number of samples seen reaches average. So ``average=10`` will begin averaging after seeing 10 samples.

algorithms.name: EllipticEnvelope
algorithms.description: Оценивает устойчивый центр и ковариацию почти нормальных числовых данных.

params.label: contamination
params.help: Ожидаемая доля для настройки порога аномалий.
params.constructor_doc: The amount of contamination of the data set, i.e. the proportion of outliers in the data set. Range is (0, 0.5].

params.label: store_precision
params.help: Сохранять обученную ковариацию или ее обратную матрицу для дальнейшей диагностики.
params.constructor_doc: Specify if the estimated precision is stored.

params.label: assume_centered
params.help: Считать вход уже центрированным при оценке ковариации.
params.constructor_doc: If True, the support of robust location and covariance estimates is computed, and a covariance estimate is recomputed from it, without centering the data. Useful to work with data whose mean is significantly equal to zero but is not exactly zero. If False, the robust location and covariance are directly computed with the FastMCD algorithm without additional treatment.

params.label: support_fraction
params.help: Доля строк для начального устойчивого определения ковариации Minimum Covariance Determinant.
params.constructor_doc: The proportion of points to be included in the support of the raw MCD estimate. If None, the minimum value of support_fraction will be used within the algorithm: `(n_samples + n_features + 1) / 2 * n_samples`. Range is (0, 1).

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Determines the pseudo random number generator for shuffling the data. Pass an int for reproducible results across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

algorithms.name: PCA
algorithms.description: Сохраняет направления с наибольшим разбросом числовых признаков.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Размер или правило выбора пространства главных компонент PCA.
params.constructor_doc: Number of components to keep. if n_components is not set all components are kept:: n_components == min(n_samples, n_features) If ``n_components == 'mle'`` and ``svd_solver == 'full'``, Minka's MLE is used to guess the dimension. Use of ``n_components == 'mle'`` will interpret ``svd_solver == 'auto'`` as ``svd_solver == 'full'``. If ``0 < n_components < 1`` and ``svd_solver == 'full'``, select the number of components such that the amount of variance that needs to be explained is greater than the percentage specified by n_components. If ``svd_solver == 'arpack'``, the number of components must be strictly less than the minimum of n_features and n_samples. Hence, the None case results in:: n_components == min(n_samples, n_features) - 1

params.label: copy
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: If False, data passed to fit are overwritten and running fit(X).transform(X) will not yield the expected results, use fit_transform(X) instead.

params.label: whiten
params.help: Сделать масштабы выходных компонент PCA сопоставимыми.
params.constructor_doc: When True (False by default) the `components_` vectors are multiplied by the square root of n_samples and then divided by the singular values to ensure uncorrelated outputs with unit component-wise variances. Whitening will remove some information from the transformed signal (the relative variance scales of the components) but can sometime improve the predictive accuracy of the downstream estimators by making their data respect some hard-wired assumptions.

params.label: svd_solver
params.help: Вариант сингулярного разложения для PCA или FactorAnalysis.
params.constructor_doc: "auto" : The solver is selected by a default 'auto' policy is based on `X.shape` and `n_components`: if the input data has fewer than 1000 features and more than 10 times as many samples, then the "covariance_eigh" solver is used. Otherwise, if the input data is larger than 500x500 and the number of components to extract is lower than 80% of the smallest dimension of the data, then the more efficient "randomized" method is selected. Otherwise the exact "full" SVD is computed and optionally truncated afterwards. "full" : Run exact full SVD calling the standard LAPACK solver via `scipy.linalg.svd` and select the components by postprocessing "covariance_eigh" : Precompute the covariance matrix (on centered data), run a classical eigenvalue decomposition on the covariance matrix typically using LAPACK and select the components by postprocessing. This solver is very efficient for n_samples >> n_features and small n_features. It is, however, not tractable otherwise for large n_features (large memory footprint required to materialize the covariance matrix). Also note that compared to the "full" solver, this solver effectively doubles the condition number and is therefore less numerical stable (e.g. on input data with a large range of singular values). "arpack" : Run SVD truncated to `n_components` calling ARPACK solver via `scipy.sparse.linalg.svds`. It requires strictly `0 < n_components < min(X.shape)` "randomized" : Run randomized SVD by the method of Halko et al. .. versionadded:: 0.18.0 .. versionchanged:: 1.5 Added the 'covariance_eigh' solver.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Tolerance for singular values computed by svd_solver == 'arpack'. Must be of range [0.0, infinity). .. versionadded:: 0.18.0

params.label: iterated_power
params.help: Число уточняющих степенных итераций приближенного матричного разложения.
params.constructor_doc: Number of iterations for the power method computed by svd_solver == 'randomized'. Must be of range [0, infinity). .. versionadded:: 0.18.0

params.label: n_oversamples
params.help: Число дополнительных пробных направлений randomized SVD.
params.constructor_doc: This parameter is only relevant when `svd_solver="randomized"`. It corresponds to the additional number of random vectors to sample the range of `X` so as to ensure proper conditioning. See :func:`~sklearn.utils.extmath.randomized_svd` for more details. .. versionadded:: 1.1

params.label: power_iteration_normalizer
params.help: Способ стабилизации внутренних степенных итераций randomized SVD.
params.constructor_doc: Power iteration normalizer for randomized SVD solver. Not used by ARPACK. See :func:`~sklearn.utils.extmath.randomized_svd` for more details. .. versionadded:: 1.1

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Used when the 'arpack' or 'randomized' solvers are used. Pass an int for reproducible results across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`. .. versionadded:: 0.18.0
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

algorithms.name: IncrementalPCA
algorithms.description: Оценивает главные компоненты по последовательным пакетам строк.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Количество компонентов смеси или новых координат преобразования.
params.constructor_doc: Number of components to keep. If ``n_components`` is ``None``, then ``n_components`` is set to ``min(n_samples, n_features)``.

params.label: whiten
params.help: Сделать масштабы выходных компонент PCA сопоставимыми.
params.constructor_doc: When True (False by default) the ``components_`` vectors are divided by ``n_samples`` times ``components_`` to ensure uncorrelated outputs with unit component-wise variances. Whitening will remove some information from the transformed signal (the relative variance scales of the components) but can sometimes improve the predictive accuracy of the downstream estimators by making data respect some hard-wired assumptions.

params.label: copy
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: If False, X will be overwritten. ``copy=False`` can be used to save memory but is unsafe for general use.

params.label: batch_size
params.help: Число строк одного вычислительного пакета соответствующего алгоритма.
params.constructor_doc: The number of samples to use for each batch. Only used when calling ``fit``. If ``batch_size`` is ``None``, then ``batch_size`` is inferred from the data and set to ``5 * n_features``, to provide a balance between approximation accuracy and memory consumption.

algorithms.name: FactorAnalysis
algorithms.description: Описывает признаки меньшим числом скрытых факторов и отдельным шумом.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Количество компонентов смеси или новых координат преобразования.
params.constructor_doc: Dimensionality of latent space, the number of components of ``X`` that are obtained after ``transform``. If None, n_components is set to the number of features.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Stopping tolerance for log-likelihood increase.

params.label: copy
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to make a copy of X. If ``False``, the input X gets overwritten during fitting.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations.

params.label: noise_variance_init
params.help: Начальные отдельные дисперсии шума FactorAnalysis.
params.constructor_doc: The initial guess of the noise variance for each feature. If None, it defaults to np.ones(n_features).

params.label: svd_method
params.help: Вариант сингулярного разложения для PCA или FactorAnalysis.
params.constructor_doc: Which SVD method to use. If 'lapack' use standard SVD from scipy.linalg, if 'randomized' use fast ``randomized_svd`` function. Defaults to 'randomized'. For most applications 'randomized' will be sufficiently precise while providing significant speed gains. Accuracy can also be improved by setting higher values for `iterated_power`. If this is not sufficient, for maximum precision you should choose 'lapack'.

params.label: iterated_power
params.help: Число уточняющих степенных итераций приближенного матричного разложения.
params.constructor_doc: Number of iterations for the power method. 3 by default. Only used if ``svd_method`` equals 'randomized'.

params.label: rotation
params.help: Дополнительное вращение компонент FactorAnalysis для интерпретации.
params.constructor_doc: If not None, apply the indicated rotation. Currently, varimax and quartimax are implemented. See `"The varimax criterion for analytic rotation in factor analysis" <https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007%2FBF02289233>`_ H. F. Kaiser, 1958. .. versionadded:: 0.24

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Only used when ``svd_method`` equals 'randomized'. Pass an int for reproducible results across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.

algorithms.name: TruncatedSVD
algorithms.description: Разлагает матрицу без центрирования, поэтому подходит для разреженных счетчиков.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Количество компонентов смеси или новых координат преобразования.
params.constructor_doc: Desired dimensionality of output data. If algorithm='arpack', must be strictly less than the number of features. If algorithm='randomized', must be less than or equal to the number of features. The default value is useful for visualisation. For LSA, a value of 100 is recommended.

params.label: algorithm
params.help: Численный способ приближенного SVD без центрирования матрицы.
params.constructor_doc: SVD solver to use. Either "arpack" for the ARPACK wrapper in SciPy (scipy.sparse.linalg.svds), or "randomized" for the randomized algorithm due to Halko (2009).

params.label: n_iter
params.help: Число уточняющих степенных итераций приближенного матричного разложения.
params.constructor_doc: Number of iterations for randomized SVD solver. Not used by ARPACK. The default is larger than the default in :func:`~sklearn.utils.extmath.randomized_svd` to handle sparse matrices that may have large slowly decaying spectrum.

params.label: n_oversamples
params.help: Число дополнительных пробных направлений randomized SVD.
params.constructor_doc: Number of oversamples for randomized SVD solver. Not used by ARPACK. See :func:`~sklearn.utils.extmath.randomized_svd` for a complete description. .. versionadded:: 1.1

params.label: power_iteration_normalizer
params.help: Способ стабилизации внутренних степенных итераций randomized SVD.
params.constructor_doc: Power iteration normalizer for randomized SVD solver. Not used by ARPACK. See :func:`~sklearn.utils.extmath.randomized_svd` for more details. .. versionadded:: 1.1

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Used during randomized svd. Pass an int for reproducible results across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Tolerance for ARPACK. 0 means machine precision. Ignored by randomized SVD solver.

algorithms.name: FastICA
algorithms.description: Ищет компоненты, которые приближенно независимы друг от друга.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Количество компонентов смеси или новых координат преобразования.
params.constructor_doc: Number of components to use. If None is passed, all are used.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations during fit.

params.label: algorithm
params.help: Совместное или последовательное выделение независимых компонент FastICA.
params.constructor_doc: Specify which algorithm to use for FastICA.

params.label: whiten
params.help: Предварительно убрать линейные корреляции и выбрать масштаб независимых компонент FastICA.
params.constructor_doc: Specify the whitening strategy to use. - If 'arbitrary-variance', a whitening with variance arbitrary is used. - If 'unit-variance', the whitening matrix is rescaled to ensure that each recovered source has unit variance. - If False, the data is already considered to be whitened, and no whitening is performed. .. versionchanged:: 1.3 The default value of `whiten` changed to 'unit-variance' in 1.3.

params.label: fun
params.help: Нелинейная функция контраста FastICA.
params.constructor_doc: The functional form of the G function used in the approximation to neg-entropy. Could be either 'logcosh', 'exp', or 'cube'. You can also provide your own function. It should return a tuple containing the value of the function, and of its derivative, in the point. The derivative should be averaged along its last dimension. Example:: def my_g(x): return x ** 3, (3 * x ** 2).mean(axis=-1)

params.label: fun_args
params.help: Дополнительные аргументы выбранной функции контраста FastICA.
params.constructor_doc: Arguments to send to the functional form. If empty or None and if fun='logcosh', fun_args will take value {'alpha' : 1.0}.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: A positive scalar giving the tolerance at which the un-mixing matrix is considered to have converged.

params.label: w_init
params.help: Начальная матрица разложения FastICA.
params.constructor_doc: Initial un-mixing array. If `w_init=None`, then an array of values drawn from a normal distribution is used.

params.label: whiten_solver
params.help: Численный вариант предварительного whitening FastICA.
params.constructor_doc: The solver to use for whitening. - "svd" is more stable numerically if the problem is degenerate, and often faster when `n_samples <= n_features`. - "eigh" is generally more memory efficient when `n_samples >= n_features`, and can be faster when `n_samples >= 50 * n_features`. .. versionadded:: 1.2

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Used to initialize ``w_init`` when not specified, with a normal distribution. Pass an int, for reproducible results across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

algorithms.name: NMF
algorithms.description: Представляет неотрицательные признаки как суммы неотрицательных компонент.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Количество компонентов смеси или новых координат преобразования.
params.constructor_doc: Number of components. If `None`, all features are kept. If `n_components='auto'`, the number of components is automatically inferred from W or H shapes. .. versionchanged:: 1.4 Added `'auto'` value. .. versionchanged:: 1.6 Default value changed from `None` to `'auto'`.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations before timing out.

params.label: init
params.help: Начальное состояние алгоритма: стартовые центры, начальная модель или способ факторизации.
params.constructor_doc: Method used to initialize the procedure. Valid options: - `None`: 'nndsvda' if n_components <= min(n_samples, n_features), otherwise random. - `'random'`: non-negative random matrices, scaled with: `sqrt(X.mean() / n_components)` - `'nndsvd'`: Nonnegative Double Singular Value Decomposition (NNDSVD) initialization (better for sparseness) - `'nndsvda'`: NNDSVD with zeros filled with the average of X (better when sparsity is not desired) - `'nndsvdar'` NNDSVD with zeros filled with small random values (generally faster, less accurate alternative to NNDSVDa for when sparsity is not desired) - `'custom'`: Use custom matrices `W` and `H` which must both be provided. .. versionchanged:: 1.1 When `init=None` and n_components is less than n_samples and n_features defaults to `nndsvda` instead of `nndsvd`.

params.label: solver
params.help: Алгоритм, который подбирает внутренние параметры модели.
params.constructor_doc: Numerical solver to use: - 'cd' is a Coordinate Descent solver. - 'mu' is a Multiplicative Update solver. .. versionadded:: 0.17 Coordinate Descent solver. .. versionadded:: 0.19 Multiplicative Update solver.

params.label: beta_loss
params.help: Функция расхождения между X и произведением матриц NMF.
params.constructor_doc: Beta divergence to be minimized, measuring the distance between X and the dot product WH. Note that values different from 'frobenius' (or 2) and 'kullback-leibler' (or 1) lead to significantly slower fits. Note that for beta_loss <= 0 (or 'itakura-saito'), the input matrix X cannot contain zeros. Used only in 'mu' solver. .. versionadded:: 0.19

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Tolerance of the stopping condition.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Used for initialisation (when ``init`` == 'nndsvdar' or 'random'), and in Coordinate Descent. Pass an int for reproducible results across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

params.label: alpha_W
params.help: Сила регуляризации одной из двух матриц NMF.
params.constructor_doc: Constant that multiplies the regularization terms of `W`. Set it to zero (default) to have no regularization on `W`. .. versionadded:: 1.0

params.label: alpha_H
params.help: Сила регуляризации одной из двух матриц NMF.
params.constructor_doc: Constant that multiplies the regularization terms of `H`. Set it to zero to have no regularization on `H`. If "same" (default), it takes the same value as `alpha_W`. .. versionadded:: 1.0

params.label: l1_ratio
params.help: Доля L1 в смеси L1 и L2.
params.constructor_doc: The regularization mixing parameter, with 0 <= l1_ratio <= 1. For l1_ratio = 0 the penalty is an elementwise L2 penalty (aka Frobenius Norm). For l1_ratio = 1 it is an elementwise L1 penalty. For 0 < l1_ratio < 1, the penalty is a combination of L1 and L2. .. versionadded:: 0.17 Regularization parameter *l1_ratio* used in the Coordinate Descent solver.

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: Whether to be verbose.

params.label: shuffle
params.help: Случайно менять порядок координат coordinate-descent решателя NMF.
params.constructor_doc: If true, randomize the order of coordinates in the CD solver. .. versionadded:: 0.17 *shuffle* parameter used in the Coordinate Descent solver.

algorithms.name: KernelPCA
algorithms.description: Выделяет компоненты в нелинейном пространстве ядра.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Количество компонентов смеси или новых координат преобразования.
params.constructor_doc: Number of components. If None, all non-zero components are kept.

params.label: kernel
params.help: Функция сравнения строк для ядерной модели.
params.constructor_doc: Kernel used for PCA.

params.label: gamma
params.help: Локальность влияния точки в подходящем ядре.
params.constructor_doc: Kernel coefficient for rbf, poly and sigmoid kernels. Ignored by other kernels. If ``gamma`` is ``None``, then it is set to ``1/n_features``.

params.label: degree
params.help: Степень полинома в преобразовании или полиномиальном ядре.
params.constructor_doc: Degree for poly kernels. Ignored by other kernels.

params.label: coef0
params.help: Свободная константа внутри полиномиального или sigmoid-ядра.
params.constructor_doc: Independent term in poly and sigmoid kernels. Ignored by other kernels.

params.label: kernel_params
params.help: Дополнительные параметры функции ядра, выбранной как callable.
params.constructor_doc: Parameters (keyword arguments) and values for kernel passed as callable object. Ignored by other kernels.

params.label: alpha
params.help: Ridge-регуляризация обучения приближенного обратного отображения KernelPCA.
params.constructor_doc: Hyperparameter of the ridge regression that learns the inverse transform (when fit_inverse_transform=True).

params.label: fit_inverse_transform
params.help: Учить приближенное обратное преобразование KernelPCA.
params.constructor_doc: Learn the inverse transform for non-precomputed kernels (i.e. learn to find the pre-image of a point). This method is based on [2]_.

params.label: eigen_solver
params.help: Численный решатель собственной задачи спектрального метода.
params.constructor_doc: Select eigensolver to use. If `n_components` is much less than the number of training samples, randomized (or arpack to a smaller extent) may be more efficient than the dense eigensolver. Randomized SVD is performed according to the method of Halko et al [3]_. auto : the solver is selected by a default policy based on n_samples (the number of training samples) and `n_components`: if the number of components to extract is less than 10 (strict) and the number of samples is more than 200 (strict), the 'arpack' method is enabled. Otherwise the exact full eigenvalue decomposition is computed and optionally truncated afterwards ('dense' method). dense : run exact full eigenvalue decomposition calling the standard LAPACK solver via `scipy.linalg.eigh`, and select the components by postprocessing arpack : run SVD truncated to n_components calling ARPACK solver using `scipy.sparse.linalg.eigsh`. It requires strictly 0 < n_components < n_samples randomized : run randomized SVD by the method of Halko et al. [3]_. The current implementation selects eigenvalues based on their module; therefore using this method can lead to unexpected results if the kernel is not positive semi-definite. See also [4]_. .. versionchanged:: 1.0 `'randomized'` was added.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Convergence tolerance for arpack. If 0, optimal value will be chosen by arpack.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations for arpack. If None, optimal value will be chosen by arpack.

params.label: iterated_power
params.help: Число уточняющих степенных итераций приближенного матричного разложения.
params.constructor_doc: Number of iterations for the power method computed by svd_solver == 'randomized'. When 'auto', it is set to 7 when `n_components < 0.1 * min(X.shape)`, other it is set to 4. .. versionadded:: 1.0

params.label: remove_zero_eig
params.help: Удалять направления KernelPCA с нулевыми собственными значениями.
params.constructor_doc: If True, then all components with zero eigenvalues are removed, so that the number of components in the output may be < n_components (and sometimes even zero due to numerical instability). When n_components is None, this parameter is ignored and components with zero eigenvalues are removed regardless.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Used when ``eigen_solver`` == 'arpack' or 'randomized'. Pass an int for reproducible results across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`. .. versionadded:: 0.18
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

params.label: copy_X
params.help: Создавать рабочую копию входной матрицы вместо разрешения менять переданный массив.
params.constructor_doc: If True, input X is copied and stored by the model in the `X_fit_` attribute. If no further changes will be done to X, setting `copy_X=False` saves memory by storing a reference. .. versionadded:: 0.18

params.label: n_jobs
params.help: Число разрешенных параллельных исполнителей.
params.constructor_doc: The number of parallel jobs to run. ``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context. ``-1`` means using all processors. See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>` for more details. .. versionadded:: 0.18

algorithms.name: Isomap
algorithms.description: Сохраняет отношения ближайших соседей в представлении меньшей размерности.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Количество компонентов смеси или новых координат преобразования.
params.constructor_doc: Number of coordinates for the manifold.

params.label: n_neighbors
params.help: Число соседей, используемых для прогноза или построения локального графа.
params.constructor_doc: Number of neighbors to consider for each point. If `n_neighbors` is an int, then `radius` must be `None`.

params.label: radius
params.help: Граница расстояния для включения соседей.
params.constructor_doc: Limiting distance of neighbors to return. If `radius` is a float, then `n_neighbors` must be set to `None`. .. versionadded:: 1.1

params.label: eigen_solver
params.help: Численный решатель собственной задачи спектрального метода.
params.constructor_doc: 'auto' : Attempt to choose the most efficient solver for the given problem. 'arpack' : Use Arnoldi decomposition to find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors. 'dense' : Use a direct solver (i.e. LAPACK) for the eigenvalue decomposition.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Convergence tolerance passed to arpack or lobpcg. not used if eigen_solver == 'dense'.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations for the arpack solver. not used if eigen_solver == 'dense'.

params.label: path_method
params.help: Алгоритм кратчайших путей в Isomap.
params.constructor_doc: Method to use in finding shortest path. 'auto' : attempt to choose the best algorithm automatically. 'FW' : Floyd-Warshall algorithm. 'D' : Dijkstra's algorithm.

params.label: neighbors_algorithm
params.help: Вычислительный способ построения ближайших соседей Isomap.
params.constructor_doc: Algorithm to use for nearest neighbors search, passed to neighbors.NearestNeighbors instance.

params.label: n_jobs
params.help: Число разрешенных параллельных исполнителей.
params.constructor_doc: The number of parallel jobs to run. ``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context. ``-1`` means using all processors. See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>` for more details.

params.label: metric
params.help: Правило измерения расстояния или сходства, если поле принадлежит алгоритму.
params.constructor_doc: The metric to use when calculating distance between instances in a feature array. If metric is a string or callable, it must be one of the options allowed by :func:`sklearn.metrics.pairwise_distances` for its metric parameter. If metric is "precomputed", X is assumed to be a distance matrix and must be square. X may be a :term:`Glossary <sparse graph>`. .. versionadded:: 0.22

params.label: p
params.help: Степень в расстоянии Минковского для подходящего метода соседей.
params.constructor_doc: Parameter for the Minkowski metric from sklearn.metrics.pairwise.pairwise_distances. When p = 1, this is equivalent to using manhattan_distance (l1), and euclidean_distance (l2) for p = 2. For arbitrary p, minkowski_distance (l_p) is used. .. versionadded:: 0.22

params.label: metric_params
params.help: Дополнительные именованные настройки функции расстояния.
params.constructor_doc: Additional keyword arguments for the metric function. .. versionadded:: 0.22

algorithms.name: LocallyLinearEmbedding
algorithms.description: Сохраняет отношения ближайших соседей в представлении меньшей размерности.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Количество компонентов смеси или новых координат преобразования.
params.constructor_doc: Number of coordinates for the manifold.

params.label: n_neighbors
params.help: Число соседей, используемых для прогноза или построения локального графа.
params.constructor_doc: Number of neighbors to consider for each point.

params.label: reg
params.help: Регуляризация локальной матрицы при построении LocallyLinearEmbedding.
params.constructor_doc: Regularization constant, multiplies the trace of the local covariance matrix of the distances.

params.label: eigen_solver
params.help: Численный решатель собственной задачи спектрального метода.
params.constructor_doc: The solver used to compute the eigenvectors. The available options are: - `'auto'` : algorithm will attempt to choose the best method for input data. - `'arpack'` : use arnoldi iteration in shift-invert mode. For this method, M may be a dense matrix, sparse matrix, or general linear operator. - `'dense'` : use standard dense matrix operations for the eigenvalue decomposition. For this method, M must be an array or matrix type. This method should be avoided for large problems. .. warning:: ARPACK can be unstable for some problems. It is best to try several random seeds in order to check results.

params.label: tol
params.help: Допуск для критерия остановки решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Tolerance for 'arpack' method Not used if eigen_solver=='dense'.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations for the arpack solver. Not used if eigen_solver=='dense'.

params.label: method
params.help: Конкретный вариант LocallyLinearEmbedding или другого преобразователя.
params.constructor_doc: - `standard`: use the standard locally linear embedding algorithm. see reference [1]_ - `hessian`: use the Hessian eigenmap method. This method requires ``n_neighbors > n_components * (1 + (n_components + 1) / 2``. see reference [2]_ - `modified`: use the modified locally linear embedding algorithm. see reference [3]_ - `ltsa`: use local tangent space alignment algorithm. see reference [4]_

params.label: hessian_tol
params.help: Допуск внутреннего определения ранга в hessian или modified LLE.
params.constructor_doc: Tolerance for Hessian eigenmapping method. Only used if ``method == 'hessian'``.

params.label: modified_tol
params.help: Допуск внутреннего определения ранга в hessian или modified LLE.
params.constructor_doc: Tolerance for modified LLE method. Only used if ``method == 'modified'``.

params.label: neighbors_algorithm
params.help: Вычислительный способ построения ближайших соседей Isomap.
params.constructor_doc: Algorithm to use for nearest neighbors search, passed to :class:`~sklearn.neighbors.NearestNeighbors` instance.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Determines the random number generator when ``eigen_solver`` == 'arpack'. Pass an int for reproducible results across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.

params.label: n_jobs
params.help: Число разрешенных параллельных исполнителей.
params.constructor_doc: The number of parallel jobs to run. ``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context. ``-1`` means using all processors. See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>` for more details.

algorithms.name: SpectralEmbedding
algorithms.description: Разлагает граф соседства в новые координаты.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Количество компонентов смеси или новых координат преобразования.
params.constructor_doc: The dimension of the projected subspace.

params.label: affinity
params.help: Как получать сходство в спектральном методе или AffinityPropagation.
params.constructor_doc: How to construct the affinity matrix. - 'nearest_neighbors' : construct the affinity matrix by computing a graph of nearest neighbors. - 'rbf' : construct the affinity matrix by computing a radial basis function (RBF) kernel. - 'precomputed' : interpret ``X`` as a precomputed affinity matrix. - 'precomputed_nearest_neighbors' : interpret ``X`` as a sparse graph of precomputed nearest neighbors, and constructs the affinity matrix by selecting the ``n_neighbors`` nearest neighbors. - callable : use passed in function as affinity the function takes in data matrix (n_samples, n_features) and return affinity matrix (n_samples, n_samples).

params.label: gamma
params.help: Локальность влияния точки в подходящем ядре.
params.constructor_doc: Kernel coefficient for rbf kernel. If None, gamma will be set to 1/n_features.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: A pseudo random number generator used for the initialization of the lobpcg eigen vectors decomposition when `eigen_solver == 'amg'`, and for the K-Means initialization. Use an int to make the results deterministic across calls (See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`). .. note:: When using `eigen_solver == 'amg'`, it is necessary to also fix the global numpy seed with `np.random.seed(int)` to get deterministic results. See https://github.com/pyamg/pyamg/issues/139 for further information.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

params.label: eigen_solver
params.help: Численный решатель собственной задачи спектрального метода.
params.constructor_doc: The eigenvalue decomposition strategy to use. AMG requires pyamg to be installed. It can be faster on very large, sparse problems. If None, then ``'arpack'`` is used.

params.label: eigen_tol
params.help: Допуск остановки при вычислении собственных направлений.
params.constructor_doc: Stopping criterion for eigendecomposition of the Laplacian matrix. If `eigen_tol="auto"` then the passed tolerance will depend on the `eigen_solver`: - If `eigen_solver="arpack"`, then `eigen_tol=0.0`; - If `eigen_solver="lobpcg"` or `eigen_solver="amg"`, then `eigen_tol=None` which configures the underlying `lobpcg` solver to automatically resolve the value according to their heuristics. See, :func:`scipy.sparse.linalg.lobpcg` for details. Note that when using `eigen_solver="lobpcg"` or `eigen_solver="amg"` values of `tol<1e-5` may lead to convergence issues and should be avoided. .. versionadded:: 1.2

params.label: n_neighbors
params.help: Число соседей, используемых для прогноза или построения локального графа.
params.constructor_doc: Number of nearest neighbors for nearest_neighbors graph building. If None, n_neighbors will be set to max(n_samples/10, 1).

params.label: n_jobs
params.help: Число разрешенных параллельных исполнителей.
params.constructor_doc: The number of parallel jobs to run. ``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context. ``-1`` means using all processors. See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>` for more details.

algorithms.name: TSNE
algorithms.description: Строит карту локальных соседств. Расстояния между далекими группами не следует читать как исходные расстояния.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Количество компонентов смеси или новых координат преобразования.
params.constructor_doc: Dimension of the embedded space.

params.label: perplexity
params.help: Эффективный размер локального окружения t-SNE.
params.constructor_doc: The perplexity is related to the number of nearest neighbors that is used in other manifold learning algorithms. Larger datasets usually require a larger perplexity. Consider selecting a value between 5 and 50. Different values can result in significantly different results. The perplexity must be less than the number of samples.

params.label: max_iter
params.help: Максимальный бюджет итераций конкретного решателя.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations for the optimization. Should be at least 250. .. versionchanged:: 1.5 Parameter name changed from `n_iter` to `max_iter`.

params.label: early_exaggeration
params.help: Временное усиление притяжения близких точек на раннем этапе t-SNE.
params.constructor_doc: Controls how tight natural clusters in the original space are in the embedded space and how much space will be between them. For larger values, the space between natural clusters will be larger in the embedded space. Again, the choice of this parameter is not very critical. If the cost function increases during initial optimization, the early exaggeration factor or the learning rate might be too high.

params.label: learning_rate
params.help: Величина шага оптимизации координат t-SNE.
params.constructor_doc: The learning rate for t-SNE is usually in the range [10.0, 1000.0]. If the learning rate is too high, the data may look like a 'ball' with any point approximately equidistant from its nearest neighbours. If the learning rate is too low, most points may look compressed in a dense cloud with few outliers. If the cost function gets stuck in a bad local minimum increasing the learning rate may help. Note that many other t-SNE implementations (bhtsne, FIt-SNE, openTSNE, etc.) use a definition of learning_rate that is 4 times smaller than ours. So our learning_rate=200 corresponds to learning_rate=800 in those other implementations. The 'auto' option sets the learning_rate to `max(N / early_exaggeration / 4, 50)` where N is the sample size, following [4] and [5]. .. versionchanged:: 1.2 The default value changed to `"auto"`.

params.label: n_iter_without_progress
params.help: Сколько последовательных проверок без достаточного улучшения разрешить до остановки.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of iterations without progress before we abort the optimization, used after 250 initial iterations with early exaggeration. Note that progress is only checked every 50 iterations so this value is rounded to the next multiple of 50. .. versionadded:: 0.17 parameter *n_iter_without_progress* to control stopping criteria.

params.label: min_grad_norm
params.help: Порог нормы градиента для остановки t-SNE.
params.constructor_doc: If the gradient norm is below this threshold, the optimization will be stopped.

params.label: metric
params.help: Правило измерения расстояния или сходства, если поле принадлежит алгоритму.
params.constructor_doc: The metric to use when calculating distance between instances in a feature array. If metric is a string, it must be one of the options allowed by scipy.spatial.distance.pdist for its metric parameter, or a metric listed in pairwise.PAIRWISE_DISTANCE_FUNCTIONS. If metric is "precomputed", X is assumed to be a distance matrix. Alternatively, if metric is a callable function, it is called on each pair of instances (rows) and the resulting value recorded. The callable should take two arrays from X as input and return a value indicating the distance between them. The default is "euclidean" which is interpreted as squared euclidean distance.

params.label: metric_params
params.help: Дополнительные именованные настройки функции расстояния.
params.constructor_doc: Additional keyword arguments for the metric function. .. versionadded:: 1.1

params.label: init
params.help: Начальное состояние алгоритма: стартовые центры, начальная модель или способ факторизации.
params.constructor_doc: Initialization of embedding. PCA initialization cannot be used with precomputed distances and is usually more globally stable than random initialization. .. versionchanged:: 1.2 The default value changed to `"pca"`.
params.documented_type: {"random", "pca"} or ndarray of shape (n_samples, n_components),             default="pca"

params.label: verbose
params.help: Количество диагностических сообщений исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: Verbosity level.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Determines the random number generator. Pass an int for reproducible results across multiple function calls. Note that different initializations might result in different local minima of the cost function. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

params.label: method
params.help: Конкретный вариант LocallyLinearEmbedding или другого преобразователя.
params.constructor_doc: By default the gradient calculation algorithm uses Barnes-Hut approximation running in O(NlogN) time. method='exact' will run on the slower, but exact, algorithm in O(N^2) time. The exact algorithm should be used when nearest-neighbor errors need to be better than 3%. However, the exact method cannot scale to millions of examples. .. versionadded:: 0.17 Approximate optimization *method* via the Barnes-Hut.

params.label: angle
params.help: Компромисс точности и скорости Barnes-Hut t-SNE.
params.constructor_doc: Only used if method='barnes_hut' This is the trade-off between speed and accuracy for Barnes-Hut T-SNE. 'angle' is the angular size (referred to as theta in [3]) of a distant node as measured from a point. If this size is below 'angle' then it is used as a summary node of all points contained within it. This method is not very sensitive to changes in this parameter in the range of 0.2 - 0.8. Angle less than 0.2 has quickly increasing computation time and angle greater 0.8 has quickly increasing error.

params.label: n_jobs
params.help: Число разрешенных параллельных исполнителей.
params.constructor_doc: The number of parallel jobs to run for neighbors search. This parameter has no impact when ``metric="precomputed"`` or (``metric="euclidean"`` and ``method="exact"``). ``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context. ``-1`` means using all processors. See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>` for more details. .. versionadded:: 0.22

algorithms.name: GaussianRandomProjection
algorithms.description: Умножает признаки на случайную матрицу для быстрого уменьшения числа координат.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Количество компонентов смеси или новых координат преобразования.
params.constructor_doc: Dimensionality of the target projection space. n_components can be automatically adjusted according to the number of samples in the dataset and the bound given by the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma. In that case the quality of the embedding is controlled by the ``eps`` parameter. It should be noted that Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma can yield very conservative estimated of the required number of components as it makes no assumption on the structure of the dataset.

params.label: eps
params.help: Допуск относительного искажения расстояний при автоматическом размере случайной проекции.
params.constructor_doc: Parameter to control the quality of the embedding according to the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma when `n_components` is set to 'auto'. The value should be strictly positive. Smaller values lead to better embedding and higher number of dimensions (n_components) in the target projection space.

params.label: compute_inverse_components
params.help: Сохранять псевдообратную матрицу случайной проекции.
params.constructor_doc: Learn the inverse transform by computing the pseudo-inverse of the components during fit. Note that computing the pseudo-inverse does not scale well to large matrices.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Controls the pseudo random number generator used to generate the projection matrix at fit time. Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

algorithms.name: SparseRandomProjection
algorithms.description: Умножает признаки на случайную матрицу для быстрого уменьшения числа координат.

params.label: n_components
params.help: Количество компонентов смеси или новых координат преобразования.
params.constructor_doc: Dimensionality of the target projection space. n_components can be automatically adjusted according to the number of samples in the dataset and the bound given by the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma. In that case the quality of the embedding is controlled by the ``eps`` parameter. It should be noted that Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma can yield very conservative estimated of the required number of components as it makes no assumption on the structure of the dataset.

params.label: density
params.help: Доля ненулевых элементов случайной разреженной проекционной матрицы.
params.constructor_doc: Ratio in the range (0, 1] of non-zero component in the random projection matrix. If density = 'auto', the value is set to the minimum density as recommended by Ping Li et al.: 1 / sqrt(n_features). Use density = 1 / 3.0 if you want to reproduce the results from Achlioptas, 2001.

params.label: eps
params.help: Допуск относительного искажения расстояний при автоматическом размере случайной проекции.
params.constructor_doc: Parameter to control the quality of the embedding according to the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma when n_components is set to 'auto'. This value should be strictly positive. Smaller values lead to better embedding and higher number of dimensions (n_components) in the target projection space.

params.label: dense_output
params.help: Возвращать плотную матрицу из поддерживающей разреженной проекции.
params.constructor_doc: If True, ensure that the output of the random projection is a dense numpy array even if the input and random projection matrix are both sparse. In practice, if the number of components is small the number of zero components in the projected data will be very small and it will be more CPU and memory efficient to use a dense representation. If False, the projected data uses a sparse representation if the input is sparse.

params.label: compute_inverse_components
params.help: Сохранять псевдообратную матрицу случайной проекции.
params.constructor_doc: Learn the inverse transform by computing the pseudo-inverse of the components during fit. Note that the pseudo-inverse is always a dense array, even if the training data was sparse. This means that it might be necessary to call `inverse_transform` on a small batch of samples at a time to avoid exhausting the available memory on the host. Moreover, computing the pseudo-inverse does not scale well to large matrices.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Controls the pseudo random number generator used to generate the projection matrix at fit time. Pass an int for reproducible output across multiple function calls. See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
params.documented_type: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

algorithms.name: XGBRegressor
algorithms.description: Обучает ансамбль деревьев средствами отдельной библиотеки бустинга.

params.label: n_estimators
params.help: Количество обучаемых компонентов, обычно деревьев.
params.constructor_doc: Number of gradient boosted trees. Equivalent to number of boosting rounds.

params.label: learning_rate
params.help: Правило или величина шага обновления; точный смысл задает модель.
params.constructor_doc: Boosting learning rate (xgb's "eta")

params.label: max_depth
params.help: Максимальное число последовательных разделений на пути дерева.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum tree depth for base learners.

params.label: reg_lambda
params.help: Сила квадратичного ограничения ответов листьев XGBoost.
params.constructor_doc: L2 regularization term on weights (xgb's lambda).

params.label: objective
params.help: Функция потерь, которую исполнитель минимизирует при обучении.
params.constructor_doc: Specify the learning task and the corresponding learning objective or a custom objective to be used. For custom objective, see :doc:`/tutorials/custom_metric_obj` and :ref:`custom-obj-metric` for more information, along with the end note for function signatures.
params.documented_type: typing.Union[str, xgboost.objective.Objective, xgboost.sklearn._SklObjWProto, typing.Callable[[typing.Any, typing.Any], typing.Tuple[numpy.ndarray, numpy.ndarray]], NoneType]

params.label: base_score
params.help: Исходный глобальный прогноз XGBoost до добавления деревьев.
params.constructor_doc: The initial prediction score of all instances, global bias.

params.label: booster
params.help: Тип обучаемого компонента XGBoost.
params.constructor_doc: Specify which booster to use: ``gbtree``, ``gblinear`` or ``dart``. .. deprecated:: 3.3.0 ``gblinear`` is deprecated and support will be removed in a future release.

params.label: callbacks
params.help: Разрешенные обработчики событий обучения исполнителя.
params.constructor_doc: List of callback functions that are applied at end of each iteration. It is possible to use predefined callbacks by using :ref:`Callback API <callback_api>`. .. note:: States in callback are not preserved during training, which means callback objects can not be reused for multiple training sessions without reinitialization or deepcopy. .. code-block:: python for params in parameters_grid: # be sure to (re)initialize the callbacks before each run callbacks = [xgb.callback.LearningRateScheduler(custom_rates)] reg = xgboost.XGBRegressor(**params, callbacks=callbacks) reg.fit(X, y)

params.label: colsample_bylevel
params.help: Доля признаков, случайно рассматриваемых при построении компонента бустинга.
params.constructor_doc: Subsample ratio of columns for each level.

params.label: colsample_bynode
params.help: Доля признаков, случайно рассматриваемых при построении компонента бустинга.
params.constructor_doc: Subsample ratio of columns for each split.

params.label: colsample_bytree
params.help: Доля признаков, случайно рассматриваемых при построении компонента бустинга.
params.constructor_doc: Subsample ratio of columns when constructing each tree.

params.label: device
params.help: Устройство выполнения поддерживающего бустинга: CPU или разрешенный GPU.
params.constructor_doc: .. versionadded:: 2.0.0 Device ordinal, available options are `cpu`, `cuda`, and `gpu`.

params.label: early_stopping_rounds
params.help: Число проверок без улучшения до early stopping бустинга.
params.constructor_doc: .. versionadded:: 1.6.0 - Activates early stopping. Validation metric needs to improve at least once in every **early_stopping_rounds** round(s) to continue training. Requires at least one item in **eval_set** in :py:meth:`fit`. - If early stopping occurs, the model will have two additional attributes: :py:attr:`best_score` and :py:attr:`best_iteration`. These are used by the :py:meth:`predict` and :py:meth:`apply` methods to determine the optimal number of trees during inference. If users want to access the full model (including trees built after early stopping), they can specify the `iteration_range` in these inference methods. In addition, other utilities like model plotting can also use the entire model. - If you prefer to discard the trees after `best_iteration`, consider using the callback function :py:class:`xgboost.callback.EarlyStopping`. - If there's more than one item in **eval_set**, the last entry will be used for early stopping. If there's more than one metric in **eval_metric**, the last metric will be used for early stopping.

params.label: enable_categorical
params.help: Включать native categorical поддержку XGBoost.
params.constructor_doc: See the same parameter of :py:class:`DMatrix` for details.

params.label: eval_metric
params.help: Показатели, вычисляемые исполнителем для внутренней отчетности или остановки.
params.constructor_doc: .. versionadded:: 1.6.0 Metric used for monitoring the training result and early stopping. It can be a string or list of strings as names of predefined metric in XGBoost (See :doc:`/parameter`), one of the metrics in :py:mod:`sklearn.metrics`, or any other user defined metric that looks like `sklearn.metrics`. If custom objective is also provided, then custom metric should implement the corresponding reverse link function. Unlike the `scoring` parameter commonly used in scikit-learn, when a callable object is provided, it's assumed to be a cost function and by default XGBoost will minimize the result during early stopping. For advanced usage on Early stopping like directly choosing to maximize instead of minimize, see :py:obj:`xgboost.callback.EarlyStopping`. See :doc:`/tutorials/custom_metric_obj` and :ref:`custom-obj-metric` for more information. .. code-block:: python from sklearn.datasets import load_diabetes from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error X, y = load_diabetes(return_X_y=True) reg = xgb.XGBRegressor( tree_method="hist", eval_metric=mean_absolute_error, ) reg.fit(X, y, eval_set=[(X, y)])

params.label: feature_types
params.help: Явные типы признаков XGBoost в порядке входных столбцов.
params.constructor_doc: .. versionadded:: 1.7.0 Used for specifying feature types without constructing a dataframe. See the :py:class:`DMatrix` for details.

params.label: feature_weights
params.help: Относительные вероятности отбора отдельных признаков XGBoost.
params.constructor_doc: Weight for each feature, defines the probability of each feature being selected when colsample is being used. All values must be greater than 0, otherwise a `ValueError` is thrown.

params.label: gamma
params.help: Минимальный выигрыш loss, необходимый для нового разделения XGBoost.
params.constructor_doc: (min_split_loss) Minimum loss reduction required to make a further partition on a leaf node of the tree.

params.label: grow_policy
params.help: Правило расширения дерева бустинга.
params.constructor_doc: Tree growing policy. - depthwise: Favors splitting at nodes closest to the node, - lossguide: Favors splitting at nodes with highest loss change.

params.label: importance_type
params.help: Как вычислять итоговую feature importance бустинга.
params.constructor_doc: The feature importance type for the feature_importances\_ property: * For tree model, it's either "gain", "weight", "cover", "total_gain" or "total_cover". * For linear model, only "weight" is defined and it's the normalized coefficients without bias.

params.label: interaction_constraints
params.help: Ограничивать, какие признаки могут совместно участвовать в одном взаимодействии дерева.
params.constructor_doc: Constraints for interaction representing permitted interactions. The constraints must be specified in the form of a nested list, e.g. ``[[0, 1], [2, 3, 4]]``, where each inner list is a group of indices of features that are allowed to interact with each other. See :doc:`tutorial </tutorials/feature_interaction_constraint>` for more information

params.label: max_bin
params.help: Количество интервалов квантования числового признака перед гистограммным обучением.
params.constructor_doc: If using histogram-based algorithm, maximum number of bins per feature

params.label: max_cat_threshold
params.help: max_cat_threshold ограничивает число категорий при оценке categorical-разделения XGBoost.
params.constructor_doc: .. versionadded:: 1.7.0 .. note:: This parameter is experimental Maximum number of categories considered for each split. Used only by partition-based splits for preventing over-fitting. Also, `enable_categorical` needs to be set to have categorical feature support. See :doc:`Categorical Data </tutorials/categorical>` and :ref:`cat-param` for details.

params.label: max_cat_to_onehot
params.help: Порог числа категорий для выбора one-hot подобного разделения XGBoost.
params.constructor_doc: .. versionadded:: 1.6.0 .. note:: This parameter is experimental A threshold for deciding whether XGBoost should use one-hot encoding based split for categorical data. When number of categories is lesser than the threshold then one-hot encoding is chosen, otherwise the categories will be partitioned into children nodes. Also, `enable_categorical` needs to be set to have categorical feature support. See :doc:`Categorical Data </tutorials/categorical>` and :ref:`cat-param` for details.

params.label: max_delta_step
params.help: Предел величины изменения ответа одного листа XGBoost.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum delta step we allow each tree's weight estimation to be.

params.label: max_leaves
params.help: Предельный бюджет листьев одного дерева поддерживающего бустинга.
params.constructor_doc: Maximum number of leaves; 0 indicates no limit.

params.label: min_child_weight
params.help: Минимальная сумма Hessian-весов в дочернем листе бустинга.
params.constructor_doc: Minimum sum of instance weight(hessian) needed in a child.

params.label: missing
params.help: Какое числовое значение исполнитель должен трактовать как пропуск.
params.constructor_doc: Value in the data which needs to be present as a missing value. Default to :py:data:`numpy.nan`.

params.label: monotone_constraints
params.help: Ограничивать направление изменения прогноза при увеличении выбранного признака.
params.constructor_doc: Constraint of variable monotonicity. See :doc:`tutorial </tutorials/monotonic>` for more information.

params.label: multi_strategy
params.help: Правило многоцелевого построения деревьев XGBoost.
params.constructor_doc: .. versionadded:: 2.0.0 .. note:: This parameter is working-in-progress. The strategy used for training multi-target models, including multi-target regression and multi-class classification. See :doc:`/tutorials/multioutput` for more information. - ``one_output_per_tree``: One model for each target. - ``multi_output_tree``: Use multi-target trees.

params.label: n_jobs
params.help: Число разрешенных параллельных исполнителей.
params.constructor_doc: Number of parallel threads used to run xgboost. When used with other Scikit-Learn algorithms like grid search, you may choose which algorithm to parallelize and balance the threads. Creating thread contention will significantly slow down both algorithms.

params.label: num_parallel_tree
params.help: Количество параллельных деревьев в одной итерации XGBoost.
params.constructor_doc: Used for boosting random forest.

params.label: random_state
params.help: Случайное зерно для воспроизводимого выбора.
params.constructor_doc: Random number seed. .. note:: Using gblinear booster with shotgun updater is nondeterministic as it uses Hogwild algorithm.

params.label: reg_alpha
params.help: L1-штраф по значениям листьев соответствующего бустинга.
params.constructor_doc: L1 regularization term on weights (xgb's alpha).

params.label: sampling_method
params.help: Правило случайного отбора строк XGBoost.
params.constructor_doc: Sampling method. Used only by the GPU version of ``hist`` tree method. - ``uniform``: Select random training instances uniformly. - ``gradient_based``: Select random training instances with higher probability when the gradient and hessian are larger. (cf. CatBoost)

params.label: scale_pos_weight
params.help: Относительный вес положительного класса в бинарном бустинге.
params.constructor_doc: Balancing of positive and negative weights.

params.label: subsample
params.help: Доля обучающих строк для очередного шага соответствующего бустинга.
params.constructor_doc: Subsample ratio of the training instance.

params.label: tree_method
params.help: Вычислительный алгоритм построения дерева XGBoost.
params.constructor_doc: Specify which tree method to use. Default to auto. If this parameter is set to default, XGBoost will choose the most conservative option available. It's recommended to study this option from the parameters document :doc:`tree method </treemethod>`

params.label: validate_parameters
